title: Harnessing the Identifiability Effect to Enhance Public Support for Redistribution
affiliations: Hebrew University - Faculty of Law and Hebrew University Jerusalem

detail.title: Harnessing the Identifiability Effect to Enhance Public Support for Redistribution

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Law and Empirical Analysis, Volume 3, No. 1, pp. 153-178, 2026

detail.abstract: This article proposes a new method of increasing public support for redistribution through tax-and-transfer law by harnessing the psychological phenomenon known as the identifiability effect. Enhancing such support is crucial, as implementing or sustaining redistributive measures is difficult in the face of unsympathetic public opinion. The article reports on the findings of three original, pre-registered experiments—conducted in Israel, England, and the United States—that substantiate the theoretical argument. The findings reveal that minimal and noninvasive identification of a single recipient can enhance people’s support for redistributive taxes—including direct income transfers—that would benefit the entire group of welfare beneficiaries. These results are relevant for the literatures on redistribution and the identifiability effect, as well as for policymakers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过利用“可识别性效应”（identifiability effect）这一心理现象，在税收与转移支付法律中增强公众对再分配的支持。通过三项预注册实验（以色列、英国、美国）证明，仅需对单个受益者进行最低限度、非侵入性的识别，即可显著提升人们对惠及全体福利受益者的再分配税收（包括直接收入转移）的支持。
AI.research_question: 如何通过税收与转移支付法律设计，利用可识别性效应来增强公众对再分配政策的支持？
AI.motivation: 再分配措施的实施或维持常因公众舆论缺乏同情而面临困难，因此寻找提升公众支持的有效方法至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可识别性效应（identifiability effect）——心理学中关于识别单个个体比识别统计群体更能激发同情与帮助行为的现象。
AI.method: 三项预先注册的实验，分别在以色列、英国和美国进行。
AI.findings: 对单个受益者进行最低限度、非侵入性的识别，能够增强人们对惠及全体福利受益者的再分配税收（包括直接收入转移）的支持。
AI.theory_contributions: 将可识别性效应从慈善捐助领域拓展到再分配政策支持领域，丰富了对再分配态度形成机制的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了一种低成本、易于操作的策略，通过调整税收与转移支付法律中的信息呈现方式，提升公众对再分配政策的支持度。

title: Amplifying Long-Horizon Equity Returns: Evidence from Long-Term Equity Anticipation Securities (LEAPS)
affiliations: University of Connecticut- Finance Department

detail.title: Amplifying Long-Horizon Equity Returns: Evidence from Long-Term Equity Anticipation Securities (LEAPS)
detail.abstract: Examining the return dynamics of long-dated at-the-money call options (LEAPS) on the SPY ETF across 30 years of rolling two-year windows under a quadratic regression framework, we document statistically and economically significant convexity in realized call returns that is robust to heteroskedasticity correction, outlier trimming, and non-overlapping window estimation. A modest 5% core-satellite allocation to LEAPS adds approximately 432 basis points to mean two-year index portfolio returns. Convexity is economically meaningful only over multiyear holding horizons, not in one-year allocations and short-put-overlay strategies. These findings support our claim that LEAPS calls harness persistent convex positive drifts in realized long-horizon aggregate equity market returns due to productivity growth and policy stability, unlike the noisy and transient short horizon returns.

AI.tldr: 本文研究30年SPY ETF长期平值看涨期权（LEAPS）的滚动两年期回报，发现其存在显著凸性，5%的配置可带来约432个基点的超额收益，且该凸性仅存在于多持有期。
AI.research_question: 长期平值看涨期权（LEAPS）的 realized 回报是否存在统计显著且经济意义显著的凸性？这种凸性是否随持有期变化？
AI.motivation: 现有文献多关注短期期权回报，对长期期权（尤其是LEAPS）的回报动态及其对组合配置的经济价值研究不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 二次回归框架、凸性（convexity）概念、核心-卫星配置策略、生产力增长与政策稳定性驱动长期回报的持续性正漂移
AI.method: 30年滚动两年期二次回归分析，采用异方差校正、异常值修剪和非重叠窗口估计进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: LEAPS回报存在统计和经济上显著的凸性；5%核心-卫星配置使两年期指数组合平均回报增加432个基点；该凸性仅对多持有期有效，一年期及短期看跌覆盖策略中不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了长期期权回报凸性的持续性来源（生产力增长与政策稳定性），区分了短期噪音与长期趋势性漂移。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了LEAPS在长期组合配置中的具体优化方案，量化了5%配置带来的超额收益。

title: Prior Knowledge-Driven Dual-View X-ray Screening with Adaptive Cross-Refinement for Prohibited Item Detection
affiliations: Naif Arab University for Security Sciences, Naif Arab University for Security Sciences and University of New South Wales (UNSW) - School of Computer Science & Engineering

detail.title: Prior Knowledge-Driven Dual-View X-ray Screening with Adaptive Cross-Refinement for Prohibited Item Detection
detail.abstract: Accurate detection of prohibited items in X-ray imagery is essential for airports and other critical infrastructure. However, current screening operations still rely heavily on human operators whose performance can decline under fatigue, workload pressure, and visual clutter. Automated artificial intelligence-based inspection offers a promising solution, but many existing methods either depend on single-view analysis, which is vulnerable to occlusion and viewpoint ambiguity, or use dual-view information without a clearly defined mechanism for translating dataset characteristics into model design. This paper proposes a prior-knowledge-driven dual-view X-ray screening framework for prohibited-item detection. The proposed system integrates an EfficientNet-B4 backbone with an Adaptive Hierarchical Cross-Refinement (AHCR) module to process complementary Overlook (OL) and Side (SD) X-ray views. The AHCR module performs hierarchical cross-view feature refinement, enabling the model to exchange complementary information between views and improve robustness against occlusion, intra-class variation, object-scale differences, and illumination changes. To make design systematic, statistical insights extracted exclusively from the Dual-View X-ray (DvXray) training split, including class distribution, object-scale variation, spatial layout, illumination characteristics, and dual-view complementarity, guide architectural and optimization choices. Experiments on the DVXray dataset, containing 15 prohibited-item categories, show that the proposed framework achieves 85.2\% mean average precision (mAP) at the image level, improving the strongest dual-view baseline by 10.4 percentage points. The system also maintains real-time detection performance of approximately 64 FPS in detection-only mode, while Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM)++ provides optional post-hoc visual explanations to support operator trust. These results demonstrate an accurate, interpretable, and computationally efficient solution for modern security-screening.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于先验知识的双视角X光违禁品检测框架（AHCR模块+EfficientNet-B4），利用数据集统计特征指导模型设计，在DVXray数据集上实现85.2% mAP，比最强基线提升10.4个百分点，同时保持实时检测速度（64 FPS）并提供可解释性。
AI.research_question: 如何利用双视角X光图像中的互补信息，结合数据集的先验统计知识，系统性地设计一个准确、高效且可解释的违禁品自动检测框架？
AI.motivation: 现有X光违禁品检测方法存在两个主要问题：1）单视角分析易受遮挡和视角模糊影响；2）双视角方法缺乏将数据集特征转化为模型设计的系统性机制。同时，人工安检存在疲劳、工作负荷大等局限，亟需可靠的自动化检测方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1）EfficientNet-B4骨干网络（高效特征提取）；2）Adaptive Hierarchical Cross-Refinement（AHCR）模块（层级跨视角特征精炼，实现双视图信息互补）；3）先验知识驱动的设计范式（基于数据集统计特征引导架构和优化选择）；4）Grad-CAM++（后验可视化解释）。
AI.method: 首先从DVXray训练集提取统计特征（类别分布、目标尺度变化、空间布局、光照特征、双视角互补性），以此指导EfficientNet-B4骨干网络和AHCR模块的设计。AHCR模块通过层级化的跨视角特征精炼，在Overlook（俯视）和Side（侧视）两个视角之间交换互补信息。最后使用Grad-CAM++提供可解释性可视化。
AI.findings: 在DVXray数据集（15类违禁品）上，该方法达到85.2% mAP（图像级别），比最强双视角基线提升10.4个百分点；检测-only模式下约64 FPS，满足实时性要求；Grad-CAM++有效支持操作员信任。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了一种先验知识驱动的双视角X光安检框架，将数据集统计特征系统性地融入模型设计；2）设计了AHCR模块实现层级跨视角特征精炼，有效提升遮挡、类内变异、尺度差异和光照变化下的鲁棒性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为机场等关键基础设施提供了一种准确（85.2% mAP）、实时（64 FPS）、可解释（Grad-CAM++）的违禁品自动检测方案；2）通过系统性的数据驱动设计方法，为双视角X光安检领域提供了可复用的方法论参考。

title: Residual-Income Preferences and Optimal Transition Dynamics: Branch Selection, Welfare, and an Analytical Benchmark
affiliations: ECONETRIX Consulting

detail.title: Residual-Income Preferences and Optimal Transition Dynamics: Branch Selection, Welfare, and an Analytical Benchmark
detail.abstract: This paper studies optimal transition dynamics in growth models with residual-income preferences. Utility depends on consumption and on the resources left after consumption for accumulation. Because consumption raises utility directly but reduces residual income, the static Hamiltonian condition generates a continuum of admissible residual-income branches, each associated with its own co-state process and candidate extremal trajectory. Since these extremals generally imply different lifetime utilities, the welfare-relevant transition path must be selected by comparing welfare across branches. The analysis delivers three results. First, the Ramsey model is recovered as a limiting case in which the residual-income margin disappears, the branch structure collapses, and the usual unique saddle path is recovered. Near this limit, admissible branches are nearly welfare-equivalent and dynamically close. Second, this near-equivalence breaks down away from the consumption-only benchmark: branch selection becomes quantitatively important for welfare, transition dynamics, and steady states. Third, under multiplicative preferences, the branch-dependent geometry of the Hamiltonian system yields a tractable linear benchmark. Once calibrated to match the welfare-selected steady state, this benchmark closely approximates the selected transition over a broad parameter region. Approximation errors display a systematic U-shaped pattern in the selected steady-state saving rate, with low-error regions that shift with capital intensity and depreciation. The results suggest that uniqueness of optimal transition dynamics is not robust to this class of residual-resource preferences. In such environments, first-order conditions identify admissible extremals, but welfare comparison selects the economically relevant path.

AI.tldr: 本文研究具有剩余收入偏好的增长模型中的最优转型动态。由于效用同时取决于消费和剩余收入，哈密顿条件产生连续多条候选极值路径，需要通过福利比较来选择最优转型路径。结果表明：拉姆齐模型是特殊极限情况；远离该极限时，分支选择对福利和转型动态影响显著；在乘法偏好下可得到可处理的线性基准模型。最终结论是，最优转型动态的唯一性对此类偏好不稳健。
AI.research_question: 在具有剩余收入偏好的增长模型中，如何从多条候选极值路径中识别出福利最优的转型动态路径？
AI.motivation: 标准增长模型（如拉姆齐模型）假设效用仅取决于消费，但现实中个体不仅关心消费，也关心积累留下的剩余资源。当偏好同时包含消费和剩余收入时，一阶条件会产生多条候选路径，传统方法无法唯一确定最优转型路径，需要新的理论框架来筛选。
AI.theoretical_framework: 剩余收入偏好（residual-income preferences）；哈密顿系统分支结构；福利比较选择机制；乘法偏好下的可线性化基准模型。
AI.method: 理论分析：构建包含消费和剩余收入的效用函数，求解哈密顿条件获得多分支极值路径，通过跨期福利比较进行路径选择。数值校准：在乘法偏好下构建线性基准模型，并与福利选定的稳态进行匹配，评估近似误差。
AI.findings: 1. 拉姆齐模型是剩余收入偏好消失时的极限情况，分支结构退化为唯一鞍路径，各分支福利和动态近似等价。2. 远离该极限时，分支选择对福利、转型动态和稳态有显著定量影响。3. 乘法偏好下可构建线性基准模型，能较好近似选定转型路径，近似误差呈U型模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了在剩余收入偏好类下，最优转型动态的唯一性不具有稳健性；提出了一阶条件识别候选路径、福利比较选择经济相关路径的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为增长模型中考虑储蓄-消费权衡的偏好提供更准确的路径选择方法；线性近似基准模型为实际政策分析提供了可操作工具。

title: Newspapers as Capable Guardians? The Impact of Newspaper Closures on Police Misreporting of Crime Statistics
affiliations: State University of New York (SUNY) - SUNY Brockport,  and State University of New York at Fredonia, State University of New York at Fredonia

detail.title: Newspapers as Capable Guardians? The Impact of Newspaper Closures on Police Misreporting of Crime Statistics
detail.abstract: Accurate crime statistics are fundamental to police accountability. Yet police have often been found to misclassify crimes and release manipulated statistics to create the appearance of effective policing. Since local newspapers typically reveal such misreporting, the widespread closure of newspapers could lead to increased misreporting. This can be conceptualized, in terms of routine activity theory, as the loss of capable guardians, or from the perspective of rational choice theory, as a reduction in expected costs for manipulating statistics. We examine how local newspaper closures (n=159) from 2002 through 2017 affect crime statistics reported by U.S. police departments, using Uniform Crime Reports data and a stacked regression difference-indifferences design. In line with expectations, we observe an increase in the rate at which rapes are classified as unfounded after local newspaper closures, but observe no change in the rate of unfounded autothefts or homicides. If changes in unfounded rates arose from shifts in record-keeping practices, changes would be apparent across crime categories. Our results thus suggest that statistical manipulation occurred after newspaper closures. However, neither the actual crime rates nor clearance rates changed after newspaper closures. Additionally, while overall county death rates remain unchanged, a substitution effect is observed for the cause of death whereby the proportion of deaths due to homicides decreased and that due to suicides increased. This suggests that certain homicides were misclassified as suicides. Results suggest that local newspapers play an important monitoring role in police accountability, serving as a check on police departments' power over crime-related information.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用美国2002-2017年间159家地方报纸关闭的数据，采用堆叠回归双重差分法，发现报纸关闭后强奸案被归类为"无根据"的比例上升，同时郡级层面自杀死亡比例上升而他杀比例下降，表明警察在失去地方媒体监督后更可能操纵犯罪统计数据。
AI.research_question: 地方报纸的关闭如何影响警察部门对犯罪统计数据的操纵行为？
AI.motivation: 准确的犯罪统计对警察问责至关重要，但警察经常被发现误报犯罪和发布操纵性统计数据。地方报纸通常会揭露这种误报行为，因此报纸的大规模关闭可能导致误报增加。本文旨在实证检验这一假设。
AI.theoretical_framework: 日常活动理论（将报纸关闭视为"有能力的监护人"的丧失）和理性选择理论（报纸关闭降低了操纵统计数据的预期成本）。
AI.method: 使用统一犯罪报告（UCR）数据，采用堆叠回归双重差分法（stacked regression difference-in-differences），分析2002-2017年间159家地方报纸关闭对警察部门报告犯罪统计数据的影响。
AI.findings: 1) 报纸关闭后，强奸案被归类为"无根据"的比例显著上升，但汽车盗窃和杀人案的"无根据"率无变化；2) 实际犯罪率和破案率无显著变化；3) 整体死亡率不变，但死亡原因出现替代效应——他杀死亡比例下降，自杀死亡比例上升，暗示部分他杀被误报为自杀。
AI.theory_contributions: 将日常活动理论和理性选择理论应用于警察统计操纵行为的研究，揭示了地方媒体作为"有能力的监护人"在抑制警察不当行为中的关键作用，拓展了问责制和信息操纵的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为地方新闻业衰退的负面社会后果提供了实证证据，强调了地方媒体在警察问责和公共信息真实性保障中的不可替代作用，对政策制定者维护地方新闻生态具有重要启示。

title: From Collectible to Speculative Asset: Attention, Scarcity, and the Boom-Bust Cycle in the Labubu Resale Market
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: From Collectible to Speculative Asset: Attention, Scarcity, and the Boom-Bust Cycle in the Labubu Resale Market
detail.abstract: I document a complete speculative cycle in the secondary market for Pop Mart's Labubu designer toys. Three sealed-case editions on StockX traded at peak premiums of 195 to 579 percent over retail and now trade 24 to 54 percent below retail. The cycle aligns with two identifiable shocks: an attention catalyst in April 2024 widely associated with Instagram exposure by BLACKPINK member Lisa, and an August 2025 supply expansion in which Pop Mart's supply chain president announced a tenfold increase in monthly plush production capacity. Worldwide Google search interest in "Labubu" was economically negligible for 152 consecutive weeks before the attention shock and reached the Trends ceiling shortly after the launch of a secondary product catalyst (Big Into Energy, April 2025). I treat the attention catalyst as more plausibly exogenous than the supply expansion (which Pop Mart chose in response to demand), and use this asymmetry to discuss what the episode does and does not identify. Pop Mart's equity peaked the same week as the supply announcement, supporting a signaling rather than physical-supply interpretation of the correction. The case extends attention-based asset pricing into the broader class of digitally coordinated scarcity markets and offers a tractable setting for studying how issuer-controlled supply expansion deflates speculative premiums.

AI.tldr: 本文记录了Pop Mart Labubu设计师玩具在StockX二级市场上的完整投机周期：从高达579%的溢价到跌破零售价，并分析了注意力冲击和供给扩张两个关键冲击的影响。
AI.research_question: 在数字协调的稀缺性市场中，注意力冲击和供给扩张如何驱动投机性资产价格的完整周期？
AI.motivation: Labubu玩具经历了从极高溢价到跌破零售价的完整周期，且可识别出外生的注意力冲击和内生的供给扩张两个事件，为研究投机泡沫提供了难得的准自然实验环境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于注意力的资产定价理论（attention-based asset pricing），扩展到数字协调的稀缺性市场（digitally coordinated scarcity markets）范畴。
AI.method: 案例研究法，利用StockX二级市场交易数据、Google Trends搜索指数和事件时间线分析。
AI.findings: 三轮密封版Labubu在StockX上的溢价峰值分别为195%至579%，现已跌至低于零售价24%至54%。注意力冲击（BLACKPINK Lisa Instagram曝光）引发价格飙升，供给扩张（产能十倍提升）导致价格崩盘。Pop Mart股价在供给公告当周见顶，支持信号效应而非实物供给的解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 将基于注意力的资产定价理论从传统金融资产扩展到设计师玩具等数字协调的稀缺性市场；揭示了发行方控制的供给扩张如何通过信号机制而非实际供需变化来消除投机溢价。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解投机性稀缺市场中发行方供给决策对二级市场价格的影响提供了可分析的研究框架；对投资者识别和管理此类市场中的泡沫风险具有启示意义。

title: Federal Student Loan Defaults Return After Pandemic Pause
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Federal Reserve Bank of New York

detail.title: Federal Student Loan Defaults Return After Pandemic Pause

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
During 2026:Q1, household debt balances increased slightly, by $18 billion, to reach $18.8 trillion, according to the latest Quarterly Report on Household Debt and Credit from the New York Fed’s Center for Microeconomic Data. Amid upticks in mortgage, HELOC, and auto balances and a seasonal decline in credit card balances, student loan balances remained unchanged. However, the share of student loan balances past due increased, nearing pre-pandemic levels at just over 10 percent. In this post, we focus on which borrowers entered default on their federal student loans over the past two quarters. We find that the average borrower entering default is nearly 40 years old, was not past due on their student loans prior to the pandemic, and is more likely to live in the South. While defaulted borrowers are more likely to be past due on other forms of debt, the overall scope of student loan defaults is still relatively low, suggesting that fears of broader contagion to other credit products are premature.

To view post: https://libertystreeteconomics.newyorkfed.org/2026/05/federal-student-loan-defaults-return-after-pandemic-pause/

AI.tldr: 2026年第一季度，家庭债务总额小幅增至18.8万亿美元。学生贷款余额持平，但违约率超10%接近疫情前水平。违约者平均年龄近40岁，疫情前未逾期，多居住在美国南部，且更可能在其他债务上逾期，但整体违约规模仍较低，暂不会引发广泛信贷传染。
AI.research_question: 哪些借款人在疫情暂停期后进入了联邦学生贷款违约状态？他们的特征是什么？
AI.motivation: 学生贷款违约率在疫情后回升至接近疫情前水平（超10%），需要识别违约人群特征以评估潜在的经济与信贷风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 家庭债务与信贷行为分析、学生贷款违约的微观经济特征研究
AI.method: 基于纽约联储家庭债务与信贷季度数据，对2026年前两个季度进入违约的联邦学生贷款借款人进行描述性统计分析。
AI.findings: 1）违约借款人平均年龄约40岁；2）疫情前并未逾期；3）更可能居住在美国南部；4）更可能在其他债务上逾期；5）但整体违约规模仍较低，信贷传染风险有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 补充了疫情后学生贷款违约人群的微观特征画像，为理解"延迟违约"现象提供了实证依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供学生贷款违约风险的用户画像，有助于针对性干预；同时缓解了对学生贷款违约扩散至其他信贷市场的过度担忧。

authors.last_name: Institute for Monetary and Financial Research

detail.title: State Dependence of Monetary Policy during Global Supply Chain Disruptions

publicationDetails.detailsText: Hong Kong Institute for Monetary and Financial Research (HKIMR) Research Paper No. 01/2026
publicationDetails.journalName: Hong Kong Institute for Monetary & Financial Research (HKIMR) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This paper is written by Xiwen Bai (Tsinghua University), Jesús Fernández‑Villaverde (University of Pennsylvania), Yiliang Li (University of International Business and Economics), and Francesco Zanetti (University of Oxford).

We investigate whether disruptions to the global supply chain influence the efficacy of monetary policy in stabilizing prices. We document three interrelated facts linking global supply chain disruptions to surging transportation costs, large imbalances in the supply and demand for goods, and rising goods prices in the post‑pandemic recovery. Building on these facts, we develop an analytical framework showing that supply chain disruptions—characterized by upstream production slack and downstream supply shortages—increase the convexity of the aggregate supply curve. This heightened convexity makes prices highly sensitive to monetary policy‑induced demand changes, while output remains relatively inelastic. Estimates from Threshold Vector Autoregression and Local Projection models are consistent with this mechanism: during periods of supply chain disruption, contractionary monetary policy induces a significantly larger decline in prices relative to the associated output cost, thereby alleviating the stabilization trade‑off.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了全球供应链中断如何影响货币政策稳定物价的有效性，发现供应链中断使总供给曲线凸性增加，导致价格对货币政策引起的需求变化高度敏感，而产出相对缺乏弹性，从而缓解了稳定权衡。
AI.research_question: 全球供应链中断是否会影响货币政策稳定物价的有效性？
AI.motivation: 后疫情复苏期间，全球供应链中断导致运输成本飙升、供需严重失衡以及商品价格上涨，这一现象引发了对货币政策传导机制是否发生变化的思考。
AI.theoretical_framework: 上游生产松弛与下游供应短缺导致总供给曲线凸性增加的分析框架。
AI.method: 阈值向量自回归（Threshold VAR）和局部投影（Local Projection）模型估计。
AI.findings: 供应链中断时期，紧缩性货币政策导致价格下降幅度显著大于相应的产出成本，从而缓解了稳定权衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从总供给曲线凸性角度揭示了供应链中断如何改变货币政策传导机制，丰富了货币政策与供应链冲击交叉领域的理论文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中央银行在供应链中断时期制定货币政策提供了实证依据，提示政策制定者在此类时期可以更有效地利用货币政策抑制通胀而无需承担过高的产出损失。

title: The Participation Reversal Puzzle
affiliations: , Swiss Finance Institute - HEC Lausanne and Columbia University - Columbia Business School

detail.title: The Participation Reversal Puzzle
detail.abstract: Risky-asset participation rose in the 1990s, then reversed after the mid-2000s despite continuing declines in financial technology costs. We explain this reversal by separating access costs from data costs. Lower access costs expand participation, but cheaper scalable data lets wealthy investors acquire more information, bid up prices, and reduce risk-adjusted returns for marginal, uninformed households. Using SCF and Addepar portfolio data, we document the model’s cross-sectional mechanisms: middle-wealth households exited, while informed investors earned higher returns and held riskier portfolios. Quantitatively, technological change accounts for 49\% of the post-2007 participation reversal and explains the post-Covid rise.

AI.tldr: 本文通过区分接入成本与数据成本，解释了为什么金融科技成本持续下降，但中产阶级反而退出了风险资产市场。研究发现，低成本数据使富裕投资者获得信息优势、推高资产价格，从而降低了普通家庭的风险调整后收益。量化分析表明，技术变革解释了2007年后49%的参与率逆转。
AI.research_question: 为什么在金融科技成本持续下降的情况下，风险资产参与率在1990年代上升后，于2000年代中期出现逆转？
AI.motivation: 传统理论认为金融科技成本下降应促进市场参与，但实际数据呈现先升后降的悖论，需要新的理论解释这一现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区分接入成本（access costs）与数据成本（data costs）的双成本模型；信息优势与价格发现机制。
AI.method: 利用SCF（Survey of Consumer Finances）和Addepar组合数据，进行截面机制分析与量化模型校准。
AI.findings: 1）中等财富家庭退出市场，而知情投资者获得更高收益并持有风险更高的组合；2）技术变革解释了2007年后49%的参与率逆转；3）模型还能解释新冠疫情后的参与率上升。
AI.theory_contributions: 将金融科技成本细分为接入成本与数据成本，揭示低成本数据可能通过信息不对称加剧而非缓解市场参与不平等的新机制。

title: Climate attitudes and informality across the North-South divide: Nonlinear dynamics and the political economy of the green transition
affiliations: Bucknell University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Climate attitudes and informality across the North-South divide: Nonlinear dynamics and the political economy of the green transition
detail.abstract: Public perceptions of the urgency of fighting climate change differ between countries and have fluctuated over time. Heterogeneity in climate change beliefs poses a problem because limiting global warming requires coordination among the leading players of the socioeconomic system in developed and developing countries. Most studies in the field have treated these two types of economies as similar systems at different stages of a linear development path. However, developing economies are structurally different as they are populated by a large informal sector that accounts for up to half of economic activity. We present a behavioural heterogeneous-agents macrodynamic model in which green attitudes evolve through peer effects and interactions with the formal/informal sectors, while firms respond to the endogenously chosen climate policy by adjusting their production technology. The model explains the endogenous emergence of up to four stable equilibria. Two have low informality but significant differences in green attitudes. We refer to them as the US vs Europe cases in the Global North. In the other two, informality is high, while we observe sharp differences in general support for mitigation policies, resembling an Asia vs Latin America scenario. Mapping the basins of attraction reveals that outcomes are path-dependent and that carbon subsidies may trap high-informality economies in non-green equilibria. We show how coordinated policies, such as an international carbon tax that operates independently of domestic attitudes, can increase the likelihood of achieving a green-formal equilibrium, provided that technology is sufficiently responsive.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个包含正规与非正规部门的异质性主体宏观动态模型，研究绿色态度的演变与气候政策的内生互动。模型发现四种稳定均衡状态（美欧/亚拉两种类型），指出碳补贴可能使高非正规经济体陷入非绿色陷阱，而独立于国内态度的国际碳税有助于实现绿色-正规均衡。
AI.research_question: 不同国家间公众对应对气候变化紧迫性的认知差异如何形成？非正规经济部门的存在如何影响绿色态度演化与气候政策效果？
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常将发达与发展中经济体视为线性发展路径上的不同阶段，但发展中经济体存在占经济活动近一半的非正规部门，这种结构性差异被忽视。理解这种异质性对于全球气候协调治理至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为异质性主体宏观动态模型，整合了绿色态度的同伴效应传播、正规/非正规部门互动、企业技术选择对气候政策的内生响应。
AI.method: 构建行为异质性主体宏观动态模型（behavioural heterogeneous-agents macrodynamic model），通过数学建模与均衡分析、吸引域映射（basins of attraction）进行数值模拟。
AI.findings: 1. 模型内生产生四种稳定均衡：两种低非正规但绿色态度差异大（美国vs欧洲）；两种高非正规但气候政策支持度差异大（亚洲vs拉丁美洲）。2. 结果具有路径依赖性。3. 碳补贴可能使高非正规经济体陷入非绿色均衡陷阱。4. 独立于国内态度的国际碳税配合足够响应性的技术，可提高实现绿色-正规均衡的可能性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将非正规经济部门的异质性纳入气候态度与政策互动的宏观分析框架。2. 揭示了发展程度与绿色转型之间非线性、多重均衡的复杂关系。3. 识别了碳补贴政策在高非正规经济体中的潜在陷阱效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为国际气候政策设计提供启示：碳税比碳补贴更适合高非正规经济体。2. 表明气候政策需考虑不同经济体的结构性差异，一刀切政策可能适得其反。3. 强调国际协调（如国际碳税）对于打破国内态度锁定的重要性。

title: When Zero Defaults Mislead: A Power-Aware Validation Framework for Credit Risk Models
affiliations: University of Nottingham

detail.title: When Zero Defaults Mislead: A Power-Aware Validation Framework for Credit Risk Models
detail.abstract: Low-default credit portfolios often produce few or zero observed defaults, making conventional probability-of-default model validation weak even when risk is materially understated. This paper develops a power-aware reporting framework for PD validation. It combines a protocol tracked OpenAlex/Crossref evidence map, transparent binomial and beta-binomial simulation, a UCI credit-card illustration, and a public Fannie Mae mortgage validation extension. The simulations show that non-rejection can be uninformative when expected defaults are small; for example, a one-sided binomial test has low power to detect a twofold PD understatement at small validation sample sizes, while power improves only as expected defaults accumulate. The public-data exercises show that discrimination, calibration, exposure-weighted error and out-of-time validation can point to different conclusions. The framework requires validators to report sample information, material alternatives, rejection thresholds, power, dependence assumptions and metric purpose before treating a pass result as evidence of model adequacy. The contribution is a reproducible validation-reporting discipline rather than a new credit-scoring algorithm.

AI.tldr: 本文针对低违约信贷组合中PD模型验证失效的问题，提出了一个"功率感知"的报告框架，通过可复现的模拟和实证分析，要求验证者事先报告样本信息、备择假设、拒绝阈值、检验功效等关键要素，以提升PD模型验证的严谨性和透明度。
AI.research_question: 在低违约信贷组合中，如何构建一个更严谨、可复现的违约概率（PD）模型验证报告框架，以避免因检验功效不足而误判模型充分性？
AI.motivation: 低违约信贷组合中观察到的违约事件极少甚至为零，传统PD模型验证方法即使面对严重低估的风险也无法有效识别，导致"通过测试"可能是一种误导性的假象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 统计检验功效分析（Power Analysis）、二项分布与Beta-二项分布模拟、信用风险模型验证理论
AI.method: 结合OpenAlex/Crossref证据图谱的协议追踪、透明二项和Beta-二项仿真模拟、UCI信用卡数据示例、Fannie Mae抵押贷款数据公开验证扩展
AI.findings: 单侧二项检验在小样本下对2倍的PD低估几乎没有检测能力；区分度、校准度、暴露加权误差和跨时间验证等不同指标可能指向矛盾结论；非拒绝结果在预期违约数很小时几乎不提供信息。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种"功率感知"的验证报告纪律，强调在验证前明确报告样本信息、实质性备择假设、拒绝阈值、检验功效、依赖假设和指标目的，填补了低违约组合验证方法论上的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和金融机构提供了一套可复现、透明的PD模型验证报告框架，避免因低功效检验而产生误导性的"模型通过验证"结论，提升风险管理质量。

Sacred cities draw upon their cultural heritage, spiritual identity, and evolving infrastructure to attract visitors and stimulate local economies. This study aims to explore how dynamic capabilities specifically sensing, seizing, and transforming shape sustainable tourism development and economic revitalization of JaiSriRam's Ayodhya amid its recent religious and infrastructural resurgence.

detail.abstract: Despite concerns that many older adults delay essential financial decisions, there is limited population-level evidence linking measured procrastination to late-life behavior. Using the first nationwide procrastination module in the Health and Retirement Study, we show that individuals with higher procrastination scores are significantly less likely to engage in core estate-planning tasks. Procrastinators are about nine percentage points less likely to have a will or trust and report lower retirement satisfaction, controlling for demographics, income, and region. We validate the behavioral measure by showing that procrastinators report worse health and exhibit some riskier behaviors, consistent with theoretical predictions. Together, these results highlight procrastination as a meaningful behavioral constraint that shapes financial and health outcomes at older ages.

AI.tldr: 利用全美首个拖延行为模块数据，研究发现拖延程度较高的老年人显著更少进行遗产规划（遗嘱/信托概率低约9个百分点），且退休满意度更低。研究验证了拖延行为的测量有效性，并指出拖延是影响老年人财务与健康结果的重要行为约束。
AI.research_question: 测量出的拖延倾向如何影响老年人晚期的财务决策（尤其是遗产规划）和退休满意度？
AI.motivation: 尽管有担忧认为许多老年人推迟关键的财务决策，但缺乏基于全美人口层面的证据来将测量到的拖延行为与晚年实际行为联系起来。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学中的拖延理论（现时偏向、自我控制问题）——拖延者倾向于推迟不愉快的任务，导致决策延迟和福利损失。
AI.method: 利用健康与退休研究（HRS）中首个全美代表性拖延模块数据，构建拖延得分，进行回归分析，控制人口统计特征、收入和地区等变量。
AI.findings: 拖延得分更高的个体拥有遗嘱或信托的概率低约9个百分点，退休满意度更低；拖延者健康状况更差，部分风险行为更多，验证了测量指标的有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在全美老年人代表性样本中实证检验拖延行为与财务决策（遗产规划）的因果关联，丰富了行为经济学中"时间不一致偏好"的理论应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示政策制定者和金融服务机构关注拖延行为对老年人财务健康的阻碍，可设计"默认选项"或简化流程等助推措施帮助老年人及时完成遗产规划。

detail.abstract: The agricultural supply chain in India suffers from multi-tier intermediary dependencies that erode farmer income by 40-60% and inflate consumer prices without commensurate quality guarantees. This paper presents FarmKart-E-Farm Connect, a full-stack Android-based agriculture marketplace that eliminates these inefficiencies by enabling direct farmer-to-consumer commerce with integrated real-time GPS delivery tracking. The system realises a four-role architecture-Consumer, Farmer, Delivery Agent, and Administratoreach served by a dedicated interface within a unified Android application (Java + XML). The backend is implemented in Node.js with Express.js following RESTful principles; Retrofit 2 handles all client-server communication across 16 annotated endpoints; MongoDB Atlas provides persistent storage across seven domain collections; Firebase Realtime Database and Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) power live delivery tracking and push notifications; and Google Maps Android SDK drives GPS-based navigation and route rendering. Advanced features include wishlist management, coupon and promo-code engine, smart product recommendations, PDF invoice generation, in-app farmer-consumer chat over Firebase, referral wallet system, dynamic pricing with auto-expiry, and order cancellation with automated refunds. An eight-stage order lifecycle (Placed → Accepted → Packed → Assigned → Picked Up → On the Way → Delivered → Completed) is orchestrated server-side with FCM notifications dispatched at every state transition. Prototype evaluation on Android 10-13 devices recorded average REST API latency below 380 ms, Firebase location propagation below 200 ms, and FCM delivery within 1.4 seconds, with zero critical crashes across a full end-to-end test cycle.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并实现了一个基于Android的全栈农业电商平台FarmKart-E-Farm Connect，通过直接连接农民与消费者、集成实时GPS配送追踪，消除了印度农产品供应链中多层中间商导致的效率损失。系统采用四角色架构，后端基于Node.js/RESTful API，前端使用Java+XML，结合MongoDB、Firebase和Google Maps等技术，实现了完整的订单生命周期管理和多项高级功能。
AI.research_question: 如何通过技术平台（全栈Android农业电商）消除印度农产品供应链中多层中间商带来的效率损失，实现农民与消费者的直接交易？
AI.motivation: 印度农产品供应链存在多层中间商依赖，导致农民收入被侵蚀40-60%，同时消费者价格被抬高但缺乏质量保证，现有市场效率低下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 农产品供应链去中间化理论、直接农民-消费者交易模式、全栈移动应用架构设计原则、RESTful API架构设计模式。
AI.method: 系统开发与原型评估：采用Android原生开发（Java+XML）、Node.js+Express.js后端、MongoDB Atlas数据库、Firebase实时数据库与云消息、Google Maps SDK等技术栈构建平台，并在Android 10-13设备上进行性能测试。
AI.findings: 原型评估显示：REST API平均延迟低于380毫秒，Firebase位置传播低于200毫秒，FCM消息投递在1.4秒内完成，全端到端测试周期中零严重崩溃。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个完整的四角色（消费者、农民、配送员、管理员）农业电商架构模型，并将八阶段订单生命周期管理、实时GPS追踪与多技术融合的架构设计系统化。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度农业供应链提供了一套可直接部署的技术解决方案，包括优惠券引擎、智能推荐、PDF发票、应用内聊天、推荐钱包系统、动态定价等实用功能，有望减少中间商剥削、提高农民收入并降低消费者价格。

detail.abstract: Banca d’Italia’s In-house Credit Assessment System (BI-ICAS) has been assessing Italian non-financial f irms’ creditworthiness within the Eurosystem’s collateral framework since 2013. BI-ICAS uses a statistical model, which produces monthly one-year probabilities of default (PDs) for around 370,000 f irms, combined with expert assessments performed by analysts on a subset of approximately 4,000 companies per year. Italian firms’ credit quality, measured by PDs, has gradually improved since 2013; in the years 2020-2022, this improvement was mainly due to policy support measures following the pandemic, and to the subsequent economic recovery. The high costs of debt and the cyclical slowdown have resulted in a slight deterioration in PDs since 2023. Disparities persist by sector, size and region. During the period observed, credit claims became more and more significant among the collateral asset classes used in Eurosystem refinancing operations, eventually becoming the predominant category. In Italy, the use of BI-ICAS assessments has facilitated banks’ access to central bank liquidity, particularly during the pandemic. In line with Eurosystem initiatives, Banca d’Italia is committed to integrating climate change-related risks into BI-ICAS assessments, using methodologies that combine quantitative and qualitative assessments to estimate the impact of transition and physical risks.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了意大利央行内部信用评估系统（BI-ICAS）自2013年以来的运行情况，包括其统计模型与专家评估相结合的信用评级方法，以及意大利企业信用质量随时间变化的趋势分析。研究还探讨了该系统在欧元体系抵押品框架中的作用，以及将气候变化风险纳入评估体系的未来方向。
AI.research_question: BI-ICAS系统如何评估意大利非金融企业的信用质量？意大利企业的信用风险在2013-2023年间如何演变？以及如何将气候变化风险纳入信用评估体系？
AI.motivation: 央行内部信用评估系统对货币政策实施和金融稳定具有重要意义，尤其在欧洲央行抵押品框架下，了解其运行机制和信用质量变化趋势对政策制定和风险管理至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信用风险评估理论、违约概率（PD）模型、央行抵押品框架理论、气候变化风险（转型风险与物理风险）评估方法。
AI.method: 统计模型（每月生成约37万家企业的年度违约概率）结合分析师专家评估（每年约4000家企业），以及定量与定性相结合的气候风险评估方法。
AI.findings: 1) 意大利企业信用质量自2013年以来逐步改善，2020-2022年改善主要得益于疫情政策支持和经济复苏；2) 2023年以来高债务成本和周期性放缓导致违约概率小幅恶化；3) 行业、规模和地区间信用质量差异持续存在；4) 信用债权在欧元体系抵押品中的重要性持续上升；5) BI-ICAS评估促进了银行获取央行流动性。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了央行内部信用评估系统在抵押品管理中的应用研究，为将气候变化风险纳入传统信用评估体系提供了方法论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行信用评估系统的设计和优化提供实际案例，为银行利用央行流动性操作提供参考，为将气候风险纳入信用风险管理提供实践路径。

detail.title: Abstract
detail.abstract: The European Union increasingly promotes target-based and result-oriented agri-environmental policies, including the use of key performance indicators (KPIs), under the Common Agricultural Policy. While the environmental and economic performance of such instruments has been widely discussed, less attention has been paid to how different stakeholder groups perceive and evaluate KPI-based governance. This study addresses this gap in multi-stakeholder research by applying Q-methodology to systematically identify stakeholder viewpoints on participation in KPI-based agri-environmental schemes in the Dutch dairy sector.,Based on Q-sorts and interviews with 24 stakeholders, including farmers, farmer collectives, government representatives, and nature organisations, four distinct viewpoints were identified. These reflect contrasting governance logics centred on clarity and trust in government, strong compensation and long-term security, realism and contextual differentiation, and distrust and autonomy. The findings show that acceptance of KPI-based schemes depends not only on expected economic returns, but also on institutional trust, perceived risk allocation, and autonomy over data and management decisions. By revealing heterogeneity in stakeholder perspectives, this study contributes to ecological economics debates on incentive design, institutional legitimacy, and result-based environmental governance.

AI.tldr: 本文运用Q方法研究荷兰 dairy 行业利益相关者对基于KPI的农业环境计划的不同看法，发现四种观点，表明接受度取决于经济回报、制度信任、风险分配和自主权。
AI.research_question: 不同利益相关者群体如何看待和评价基于关键绩效指标（KPI）的农业环境治理？
AI.motivation: 欧盟日益推行基于目标和结果的农业环境政策（如KPI），但其环境与经济绩效已被广泛讨论，不同利益相关者如何看待这种治理模式却鲜有关注。
AI.theoretical_framework: 治理逻辑、制度信任、风险分配、自主权等维度，结合生态经济学中的激励设计、制度合法性与结果导向治理理论。
AI.method: Q方法论：对24位利益相关者（农民、农民集体、政府代表、自然保护组织）进行Q排序和访谈。
AI.findings: 识别出四种观点：（1）重视政府清晰度和信任；（2）强调强补偿与长期保障；（3）现实主义与因地制宜；（4）不信任与追求自主权。接受度取决于经济回报、制度信任、风险感知及数据/管理自主权。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了利益相关者对KPI治理的异质性看法，丰富了生态经济学中关于激励设计、制度合法性和结果导向环境治理的讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计更被各群体接受的KPI农业环境计划提供依据，提示需关注信任、风险分配和自主权等非经济因素。

title: Several shades of input-output models for geosectoral stress testing

detail.title: Several shades of input-output models for geosectoral stress testing
detail.abstract: Input-output (IO) modeling has become the standard methodology for stress testing economic value chains against production and cost inflation shocks. Notwithstanding their widespread deployment, some deficiencies exist in the literature regarding investigations into the varied properties and extensive applications of these modeling frameworks, especially when applied for stress testing exercises. This paper addresses these deficiencies by focusing on how model outcomes are affected by the assumed origin of a shock-whether it is applied to final demand, gross value added, intermediate consumption, or total output variables. Moreover, we look on how different parts of the modeling framework interact, in particular between price and production equations. We also show the relation between the introduction of binary passthrough mechanisms and the asbence of geosectoral feedbacks, and more generally how the passthrough rates can be integrated in all Leontief stressing assumptions. We present a thorough review that integrates theoretical principles with practical applications, drawing on examples from the environmental stress tests (carbon price or biodiversity intactness) currently required of financial institutions, to illuminate the theories of IO modeling for stress testing.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了投入产出（IO）模型在压力测试中的应用，重点分析了不同冲击来源（最终需求、总增加值、中间消费、总产出）对模型结果的影响，以及价格方程与生产方程之间的交互机制，并讨论了二元传导机制与地理部门反馈缺失之间的关系。
AI.research_question: 投入产出模型在压力测试中，冲击来源的设定（最终需求、总增加值、中间消费、总产出）如何影响模型结果？价格方程与生产方程如何交互？二元传导机制如何与地理部门反馈缺失相关联？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对IO模型在压力测试中的多样化属性和广泛应用研究不足，尤其是在不同冲击假设下模型结果的差异以及模型内部机制交互方面存在空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投入产出（IO）模型、Leontief压力测试假设、价格与生产方程交互机制、二元传导机制（passthrough mechanisms）
AI.method: 理论综述与实务案例结合，以金融机构环境压力测试（碳价格、生物多样性完整性）为例，阐明IO模型在压力测试中的理论原理。
AI.findings: 冲击来源的假设（最终需求、总增加值、中间消费或总产出）显著影响模型结果；价格方程与生产方程存在交互效应；二元传导机制的引入与地理部门反馈缺失之间存在关联；传导率（passthrough rates）可整合到所有Leontief压力测试假设中。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统揭示了冲击来源假设对IO模型结果的差异影响，阐明了价格与生产方程的交互机制，并将二元传导机制与地理部门反馈缺失的理论关系进行了明确化。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构进行环境压力测试（如碳定价、生物多样性风险）提供了IO模型优化使用的理论指导，帮助实务人员更准确地设定冲击假设和解读模型结果。

title: Towards a Theory of Modular Natives: Explaining Superscaling, China's Greatest Innovation Yet
affiliations: University of Oxford - Said Business School, IT University of Copenhagen, University of Oxford - Saïd Business School and University of Oxford

detail.title: Towards a Theory of Modular Natives: Explaining Superscaling, China's Greatest Innovation Yet
detail.abstract: First, we present a new theory, the "theory of modular natives." A modular native is a basic building block that is born modular, e.g., a solar cell. The theory predicts that using modular natives in building things reduces complexity and improves predictability, resulting in better outcomes and faster scale-up. Second, we test the theory on the largest dataset of its kind. We find, at a high level of statistical significance, that modular natives operate under a fundamentally different risk regime than other project types, with finite and predictable risk, in contrast to non-natives that have infinite and unpredictable risk. The findings help explain why modularity is key to successful building while bespokeness often leads to failure. Third, we relate our findings to economic and geopolitical development, arguing that China understands modular natives and scale-up better than any other geography and that this is key to China's swiftly growing dominance in renewables, batteries, EVs, robots, etc. We argue that China's mastery of modularity and scale-up is a major innovation in its own right, among the greatest and most impactful in human history, falsifying the common notion that China cannot innovate. Business and government outside China ignore these findings at their peril. Finally, we spell out policy and practice implications and identify areas for further research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"模块化原生体"理论，指出使用天生模块化的基本单元（如太阳能电池）构建系统能降低复杂度、提升可预测性。通过大规模数据集验证，发现模块化原生体的风险有限且可预测，而非原生体风险无限且不可预测。研究解释了模块化为何是成功建造的关键，并论证中国在模块化与规模化方面的掌握是其在新能源等领域快速崛起的重要原因。
AI.research_question: 模块化原生体如何影响复杂系统的构建成功率、风险特征及规模化速度？中国在模块化能力上与其他经济体的差异如何解释其产业崛起？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为模块化有助于系统构建，但缺乏系统的理论框架和大规模实证检验。同时，"中国不能创新"的论断与现实中中国在新能源等领域的快速领先形成矛盾，亟需理论解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: "模块化原生体"理论：天生模块化的基本单元（如太阳能电池）作为构建模块，其可组合性和可预测性显著优于需要定制化设计的非原生体系统。
AI.method: 基于目前同类研究中最大的数据集进行统计检验，对比模块化原生体与非原生体项目的风险特征。
AI.findings: 模块化原生体项目风险有限且可预测，而非原生体项目风险无限且不可预测；中国在模块化与规模化的掌握上领先全球，是其可再生能源、电池、电动车、机器人等领域快速崛起的关键。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"模块化原生体"这一新理论，为理解模块化如何降低系统复杂度和风险提供了系统框架；将模块化能力重新定义为一种重大创新形式，挑战"中国不能创新"的传统认知。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和政府提供了模块化策略的实践指导，指出忽视模块化与规模化能力的国家将面临竞争劣势；建议政策制定者关注模块化技术的推广与应用。

title: Investment Decisions for Green Hydrogen under the Renewable Fuels of Non-Biological Origin (RFNBO) Framework
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Technical University of Denmark and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Investment Decisions for Green Hydrogen under the Renewable Fuels of Non-Biological Origin (RFNBO) Framework
detail.abstract: The decarbonization of the energy sector and the increasing penetration of renewable energy sources have intensified the need for system flexibility and sector coupling solutions. Green hydrogen production via electrolysis represents a promising pathway to integrate variable renewable electricity while complying with European climate policy objectives. This paper proposes an investment optimization model for a hybrid facility combining a wind power plant and an electrolyzer, explicitly aligned with the European Union’s green hydrogen regulatory framework. The model incorporates the additionality requirement and the temporal and geographical correlation criteria defined in the RFNBO Delegated Act, ensuring that hydrogen production qualifies as renewable. The framework further accounts for real-world financing constraints, reflecting the requirements of financial institutions for predictable revenues and bankable project structures. Long-term Power Purchase Agreements and Hydrogen Purchase Agreements are included to represent contractual arrangements that secure returns on investment. The investment problem is formulated as a long-term decision-making model that captures interactions between electricity and hydrogen markets. A detailed case study is presented to analyze the impact of evolving market prices on project profitability. The results provide insights into optimal investment decisions and highlight the economic trade-offs associated with hybrid wind–hydrogen systems under current regulatory and market conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种混合风能-氢能设施的投资优化模型，该模型遵循欧盟绿色氢能监管框架（包括额外性要求及时空相关性标准），并纳入长期购电协议和购氢协议等融资约束，以分析电力与氢市场交互下的最优投资决策与项目盈利能力。
AI.research_question: 在欧盟绿色氢能监管框架下，如何优化混合风能-氢能设施的投资决策？
AI.motivation: 能源行业脱碳及可再生能源渗透率提高催生了对系统灵活性和部门耦合的需求，绿色氢能是整合可变可再生能源的关键路径，但需在欧盟监管框架下解决投资优化问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投资优化模型、欧盟RFNBO授权法案（额外性要求、时空相关性标准）、长期购电协议（PPA）与购氢协议（HPA）的融资约束理论。
AI.method: 提出长期投资决策模型，捕捉电力与氢能市场交互；通过案例研究分析市场价格变化对项目盈利能力的影响。
AI.findings: 揭示了混合风能-氢能系统在当前监管与市场条件下的最优投资决策及经济权衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 将欧盟绿色氢能监管框架（额外性要求、时空相关性）与融资约束（PPA/HPA）纳入统一投资优化模型，拓展了可再生能源-氢能系统投资决策的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和投资者在欧盟监管环境下评估混和风能-氢能项目的经济可行性及最优投资规模提供了量化分析工具。

title: How Markets Price Reality: Governing Prediction Markets and 'Post-truth' Economies
affiliations: Queen's University (Canada)

detail.title: How Markets Price Reality: Governing Prediction Markets and 'Post-truth' Economies
detail.abstract:
Prediction markets are commonly framed as tools for forecasting and information aggregation. This report argues, however, that they pose deeper governance challenges at the intersection of financial speculation, information integrity and democratic legitimacy.

By attaching financial incentives to outcomes such as elections, wars and public health events, prediction markets do not merely reflect uncertainty. They can actively shape how reality is publicly described, interpreted and verified. Under post-truth conditions, these platforms convert contested facts into tradable claims, intensifying epistemic risk while feeding back into media narratives and institutional decision-making processes.

The expansion of prediction markets is driven by broader processes of financialization and may be further accelerated by artificial intelligence, which increasingly automates speculative dynamics and recursive feedback loops.

This report concludes that prediction markets should be governed as critical information infrastructures. Doing so requires stronger regulatory oversight, greater transparency, protections for knowledge producers and sustained investment in non-speculative forms of public forecasting capacity.

AI.tldr: 本文认为预测市场不仅仅是信息聚合工具，更是处于金融投机、信息真实性和民主合法性交叉点的深层治理挑战。预测市场通过金融激励将争议性事实转化为可交易的主张，在"后真相"条件下加剧了认知风险，并反馈到媒体叙事和制度决策中。报告主张将预测市场作为关键信息基础设施进行监管。
AI.research_question: 预测市场如何从信息聚合工具转变为影响现实描述的治理挑战？在后真相和金融化背景下，这种转变带来了哪些风险？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多将预测市场视为信息聚合和预测工具，忽视了其在金融投机、信息真实性与民主合法性交叉点上引发的深层治理问题，特别是在"后真相"时代和人工智能加速发展的背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 后真相理论、金融化理论、信息基础设施理论、认知风险理论
AI.method: 理论分析与论证性报告
AI.findings: (1) 预测市场通过金融激励不仅反映不确定性，还主动塑造现实被描述、解释和验证的方式；(2) 在后真相条件下，预测市场将争议性事实转化为可交易主张，加剧认知风险；(3) 预测市场的扩张由金融化进程驱动，并可能被人工智能进一步加速；(4) 需要将预测市场作为关键信息基础设施进行治理。
AI.theory_contributions: 将预测市场从技术性预测工具重新概念化为塑造公共认知和现实建构的制度安排，拓展了信息治理和认知风险的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了政策建议：加强监管透明度、保护知识生产者、投资非投机性公共预测能力建设。

title: Design and Research of a Two-Stage Fall Detection Algorithm for Escalator Scenes
affiliations: Nanjing Institute of Technology, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Nanjing Institute of Technology

detail.title: Design and Research of a Two-Stage Fall Detection Algorithm for Escalator Scenes
detail.abstract: As an essential component of urban public transportation systems, escalators play a critical role in ensuring passenger safety. Among various safety incidents, passenger falls are particularly hazardous, as delayed intervention may lead to severe secondary injuries. To address the challenges of fall detection in complex escalator environments, this study proposes a two-stage fall recognition method that integrates object detection and human pose estimation. First, passenger detection and continuous trajectory acquisition are achieved using the YOLOv10 object detection algorithm combined with the ByteTrack multi-object tracking framework. By incorporating posture variation features and confidence accumulation within a temporal window, high-confidence fall candidates are identified in the first stage. Subsequently, AlphaPose is employed to extract human skeletal keypoints, and a temporal modeling network based on Gated Recurrent Units (GRU) is constructed to perform secondary classification of fall behaviors. This two-stage strategy effectively improves detection accuracy while reducing false positives. Experimental validation on a self-built escalator passenger fall dataset demonstrates that the proposed method significantly enhances recognition accuracy and robustness while maintaining real-time performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合目标检测和人体姿态估计的两阶段扶梯跌倒检测方法，先通过YOLOv10+ByteTrack进行乘客检测和轨迹追踪，再利用AlphaPose提取骨骼关键点并用GRU时序网络进行二次分类，显著提高了检测精度和鲁棒性。
AI.research_question: 如何在复杂的扶梯环境中实现高精度、低误报的乘客跌倒检测？
AI.motivation: 扶梯作为城市公共交通的重要组成部分，乘客跌倒事故危害大，迟滞干预可能导致严重二次伤害。现有检测方法在复杂扶梯环境中面临挑战，需要更精准、鲁棒的跌倒识别技术。
AI.theoretical_framework: 目标检测（YOLOv10）、多目标跟踪（ByteTrack）、人体姿态估计（AlphaPose）、时序建模（门控循环单元GRU）
AI.method: 两阶段跌倒识别方法：第一阶段利用YOLOv10+ByteTrack实现乘客检测与连续轨迹获取，结合姿态变化特征和置信度累积识别高置信度跌倒候选；第二阶段利用AlphaPose提取人体骨骼关键点，构建基于GRU的时序建模网络进行二次分类。
AI.findings: 在自建扶梯乘客跌倒数据集上，该方法在保持实时性的同时显著提升了识别准确率和鲁棒性，有效降低了误报率。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了两阶段跌倒检测框架，将目标检测与人体姿态估计有机结合；构建了基于GRU的时序建模网络用于跌倒行为的二次分类，提升了复杂场景下的检测性能。
AI.practical_contributions: 为扶梯安全监控提供了高精度、低误报、实时的跌倒检测解决方案，有助于及时干预、预防二次伤害，保障乘客安全。

title: Rapid Quantitative Analysis of Herbal Extraction Process using Near-infrared Spectroscopy: An Integrated Modeling Framework
affiliations: Shandong University, Shandong Yifang Pharmaceutical Co. Ltd., Shandong Yifang Pharmaceutical Co. Ltd., Shandong University, Shandong Yifang Pharmaceutical Co. Ltd. and Shandong University

detail.title: Rapid Quantitative Analysis of Herbal Extraction Process using Near-infrared Spectroscopy: An Integrated Modeling Framework
detail.abstract: In the advanced processing of herbal medicines, rapid and non-destructive quality detection is crucial for ensuring process stability and final product quality. In recent years, portable near-infrared (NIR) spectrometers have been highly adopted due to their flexible deployment. However, limited by the inherent low signal-to-noise ratio and finite spectral resolution of portable instruments, qualitative or quantitative analysis models struggle to maintain long-term robustness. Therefore, taking the advanced processing of Angelica dahurica, a widely used medicinal herb, as an example, this study proposed a full-lifecycle NIR modeling and maintenance framework encompassing ’augmentation-optimization-updating’ (AOU). Firstly, addressing the issue of limited information acquired by portable instruments, a data augmentation module was included, utilizing generative adversarial network to generate high-quality synthetic spectra. Secondly, the Bayesian optimization algorithm was introduced to automatically optimize the parameters of SVR models. Finally, to cope with fluctuations caused by different batches of raw materials, a dynamic model updating strategy was designed, allowing the model to complete automatic calibration by simply adding a small number of new samples. The implementation of the AOU framework increased the R2p values from 0.6503-0.9242 to 0.8562-0.9714, with an average increase of 18.38%, and decreased the RMSEP values from 0.0008-0.0033 mg·mL-1 to 0.0006-0.0020 mg·mL-1, with an average decrease of 48.86%. This framework effectively addresses the challenge of maintaining long-term stability for portable NIR sensors on production lines, providing a robust, low-cost, and highly adaptable paradigm for their large-scale deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为AOU（增强-优化-更新）的全生命周期近红外建模与维护框架，通过生成对抗网络数据增强、贝叶斯优化SVR参数和动态模型更新策略，有效解决了便携式近红外光谱仪在中药加工中因信噪比低、分辨率有限导致的模型长期鲁棒性不足问题。以白芷加工为例，该框架使R²从0.6503-0.9242提升至0.8562-0.9714（平均提升18.38%），RMSEP从0.0008-0.0033 mg·mL⁻¹降至0.0006-0.0020 mg·mL⁻¹（平均降低48.86%）。
AI.research_question: 如何解决便携式近红外光谱仪在中药加工生产线上因低信噪比和有限分辨率导致的定性/定量分析模型长期鲁棒性不足的问题？
AI.motivation: 便携式近红外光谱仪虽因部署灵活被广泛采用，但其固有的低信噪比和有限光谱分辨率限制了模型的长期稳定性，亟需一种全生命周期的建模与维护框架来保障中药加工过程中质量检测的持续可靠性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生成对抗网络（GAN）数据增强、贝叶斯优化算法、支持向量回归（SVR）模型、动态模型更新策略。
AI.method: 以白芷加工为例，提出"增强-优化-更新"（AOU）三模块框架：（1）数据增强模块：利用生成对抗网络生成高质量合成光谱；（2）参数优化模块：采用贝叶斯优化算法自动优化SVR模型参数；（3）动态更新模块：通过添加少量新样本实现模型自动校准。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了面向便携式NIR传感器的全生命周期建模与维护理论框架（AOU），将数据增强、超参数自动优化与动态模型更新三者有机整合，为低信噪比、有限分辨率场景下的光谱分析模型长期稳定性提供了系统性解决方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 为便携式近红外光谱仪在中药加工生产线上的大规模部署提供了一种鲁棒性强、成本低、适应性高的可行范式，显著提升了白芷加工过程中质量检测的精度和长期稳定性。

detail.abstract:
This study investigates the determinants of cost overruns in public procurement contracts within the Hellenic Republic during the 2017-2019 pre-COVID-19 period, a timeframe characterized by intensive fiscal adjustments and the primary phase of digital transformation. Public procurement contracts are defined as the formal legal framework and binding agreements between the state and private entities for the provision of goods like specialized services, materials, infrastructure construction, and software development. The purpose of this research is to move beyond descriptive analysis and establish a predictive framework for budget deviations, establishing a decision-support tool for fiscal oversight and investment stability. The research design incorporates empirically validated "red flag" indicators associated with corruption risks and procedural anomalies (Ferwerda et al., 2017; Fazekas & Kocsis, 2017). We test two primary sets of hypotheses. Regarding the first, the null hypothesis (H0) states that digital maturity, Fintech integration, and procurement procedure types do not affect cost overruns, while the alternative hypothesis (H1) posits that digital maturity significantly reduces overruns, particularly in non-competitive procedures like direct awards, by mitigating information asymmetry. Regarding the second, the null hypothesis (H0') suggests that a contractor's position in the procurement network has no impact on fiscal performance, whereas the alternative hypothesis (H1') argues that high network centrality and market concentration are significant predictors of administrative overcapacity and cost escalation (Wachs et al., 2021; Shabani Ardakani & Nik-Bakht, 2021). 
The digitalization of procurement processes through e-procurement systems has been shown to improve transparency and reduce costs. Empirical evidence from Bangladesh (Blum et al., 2023) demonstrates increased transparency, bidder participation, higher discounts, and significant fiscal savings following the implementation of electronic systems. Similarly, the introduction of digital platforms in Argentina led to reduced procurement prices and increased competition (De Michele & Pierri, 2020). 
The methodology follows a multi-stage risk-based sampling design. From an initial population of 573,269 contracts (KIMDIS), a final analytical dataset was utilized through a manual audit process. The study innovates by applying the predictive model across three distinct scenarios to isolate risk in three stages. First stage is called Planning Deviation, thus it means From Notice to Corrected Signature (N=923). Second stage is referred to Execution Overrun thus it means From Signature to Final Payment (N=1,791). Finally the third stage is named End-to-End Joint Total Fiscal Deviation thus it means From Original Estimate to Final Payment (N=747).
A Random Forest Regressor was employed to predict fiscal slippage. The model demonstrates robust predictive power during the planning stage (R²=22.7%), while revealing a high degree of stochastic volatility during the execution phase, where cost overruns appear less predictable. Results confirm that while digital transparency and procedural types (Fintech proxies) contribute to efficiency, their impact is secondary to the structural influence of contractor networks. Specifically, network centrality (SNA) emerges as a primary driver of deviations (approx. 17% importance), significantly outweighing the impact of political election cycles, which remained marginal. Sector-specific analysis identifies high-risk areas, with consultancy services and cleaning products exhibiting average overruns exceeding 200% during the execution stage. These results offer actionable insights for the Greek Ministry of Finance to safeguard public investments and enhance fiscal discipline.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用随机森林回归模型，分析希腊2017-2019年公共采购合同中的成本超支决定因素，发现承包商网络中心性是预算偏离的主要驱动因素，其影响力远超政治选举周期，而数字成熟度的影响相对次要。
AI.research_question: 希腊公共采购合同中成本超支的决定因素是什么？如何建立预算偏离的预测框架？
AI.motivation: 在希腊财政紧缩和数字化转型的背景下，公共采购成本超支问题严重，现有研究多停留在描述性分析，缺乏预测性决策工具。本研究旨在建立基于"红旗指标"的预测模型，为财政监督和投资稳定性提供支持。
AI.theoretical_framework: 腐败风险与程序异常"红旗指标"理论（Ferwerda et al., 2017; Fazekas & Kocsis, 2017）；采购网络中心性与行政过载理论（Wachs et al., 2021）；信息不对称理论；数字化转型与透明度理论。
AI.method: 多阶段风险抽样设计，从573,269份合同中通过人工审计获得分析数据集。采用随机森林回归模型，分三个阶段（规划偏差、执行超支、全流程联合偏差）进行预测分析，并结合社会网络分析（SNA）衡量承包商网络中心性。
AI.findings: 规划阶段模型预测力较好（R²=22.7%），执行阶段成本超支随机波动性强，可预测性低。网络中心性是预算偏离的首要驱动因素（重要性约17%），远超政治选举周期的影响。咨询服务和清洁产品在执行阶段平均超支超200%。数字透明度与程序类型对效率有贡献，但影响弱于承包商网络结构。
AI.theory_contributions: 将社会网络分析引入公共采购成本超支预测，验证了承包商网络中心性作为预算偏离关键预测因子的理论地位；揭示了数字化转型对成本控制的有限性，挑战了"数字化本身即能解决腐败问题"的简化假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为希腊财政部提供了可操作的公共投资保护工具，识别了高风险的合同类型（咨询、清洁产品）和阶段（执行阶段），支持优先审计资源的精准配置；建立了三阶段风险筛查框架，可嵌入财政监督流程。

detail.title: Carbon Uncertainty and Asset Prices

keywords: random forest imputation of carbon emissions and uncertainty

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2026-63
publicationDetails.journalName: Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We find that measurement uncertainty in firms' carbon intensity commands a positive risk premium, distinct from and alongside a robust premium associated with carbon-intensity levels. Because most emissions are estimated rather than disclosed, our main contribu­tion is to construct an observation-level measure of carbon-data precision at scale: for each firm-month, we quantify the uncertainty of the underlying carbon signal. We conceptually separate estimation risk (statistical error from inferring emissions under sparse firm infor­mation) from model risk, proxied by cross-vendor disagreement. Using a replicable Multiple Imputation by Chained Equations (MICE) framework combined with Random Forests, we jointly estimate firm-month emissions, carbon intensity, and uncertainty for the full CRSP universe, overcoming the selection bias inherent in vendor-restricted samples. Training on self-disclosing firms, we show that vendor-estimated data are largely redundant: adding ven­dor observations provides little incremental information beyond disclosures, consistent with estimates being anchored to the same disclosure backbone. By contrast, imputations within vendor-covered universes can embed selection bias and materially alter asset-pricing infer­ences. Overall, investors price not only carbon exposure but also carbon opacity.

AI.tldr: 本文发现企业碳排放强度的测量不确定性（碳不透明度）具有独立于碳排放水平之外的正风险溢价。作者构建了企业-月度层面的碳数据精度度量，通过多重插补与随机森林方法估计CRSP全样本的排放量和不确定性，发现投资者不仅为碳暴露定价，也为碳不透明度定价。
AI.research_question: 企业碳排放强度的测量不确定性是否被投资者定价？即碳不透明度是否具有独立于碳强度水平之外的资产定价效应？
AI.motivation: 大多数企业的碳排放数据来自估算而非披露，导致碳数据存在测量不确定性，但现有研究缺乏对此不确定性的系统度量及其资产定价含义的探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险溢价理论、碳风险定价、信息不确定性/模糊性（ambiguity）理论、估计风险与模型风险区分框架
AI.method: 使用多重插补链式方程（MICE）结合随机森林，在CRSP全样本上联合估计企业-月度排放量、碳强度及其不确定性。构建观察层面的碳数据精度度量，区分估计风险（统计误差）与模型风险（跨供应商分歧）。利用自我披露企业数据训练模型，评估供应商估计数据的增量信息价值。
AI.findings: 碳强度测量不确定性具有独立于碳强度水平的正风险溢价；供应商估计数据相对企业自我披露信息冗余；基于供应商覆盖样本的插补存在选择性偏误，会实质性改变资产定价结论。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在大样本中系统度量碳数据不确定性并验证其独立的资产定价效应；区分估计风险与模型风险两种不确定性来源；揭示供应商碳数据的冗余性与选择性偏误问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供碳数据精度的可操作度量指标；提醒利益相关者关注估算碳排放数据的不确定性风险；为监管机构推动碳信息披露标准化提供实证依据。

detail.title: Global Policy Spillovers: How Environmental Policies Propagate through Product Attributes

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2026-64
publicationDetails.journalName: Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: How should policymakers evaluate policy impacts when firms design products for global markets? Standard economic analyses typically focus on domestic outcomes, implicitly assuming that policies affect only the jurisdiction in which they are enacted. Yet multinational firms often harmonize product design across markets, creating the potential for policies implemented in one country to generate global spillovers through changes in product attributes. We call this phenomenon "attribute propagation" and develop a framework to measure and assess its quantitative importance. Applying this framework to an environmental policy affecting automobiles, we find that a fuel-economy subsidy in Japan led to significant improvements in the fuel economy of vehicles sold in the United States. We then develop a model of multinational automobile markets featuring cross-market cost complementarity as a key mechanism driving attribute propagation. Using the estimated model, we conduct counterfactual simulations to quantify environmental benefits accounting for the policy's global spillover effects. We find that global spillover effects are first-order-a majority of the CO 2 emissions reductions induced by the Japanese policy arise through its impact on the U.S. automobile market. These findings suggest that standard economic analyses that abstract from attribute propagation can substantially understate the full policy impact. More broadly, attribute propagation provides a new lens for evaluating environmental, safety, antitrust, and technology policies in a global economy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"属性传播"概念，即一国政策通过跨国公司的全球产品设计产生跨境溢出效应。以日本的燃油经济性补贴政策为例，发现该政策通过影响汽车产品属性，显著改善了美国市场的燃油经济性，且大部分碳排放减排来自美国市场，表明忽略属性传播的传统分析会严重低估政策效果。
AI.research_question: 当跨国企业为全球市场设计产品时，政策制定者应如何评估政策影响？一国政策的全球溢出效应（属性传播）的定量重要性有多大？
AI.motivation: 传统的政策评估仅关注国内结果，隐含假设政策只影响实施管辖区域。但跨国企业常在全球市场间统一产品设计，使得一国政策可能通过产品属性变化产生全球溢出。现有研究对此现象及其定量重要性缺乏系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 属性传播框架；跨市场成本互补性（cross-market cost complementarity）机制；跨国汽车市场模型。
AI.method: 构建属性传播测量框架；以日本燃油经济性补贴政策为案例进行实证分析；开发跨国汽车市场结构模型，纳入跨市场成本互补性；利用估计模型进行反事实模拟。
AI.findings: 日本燃油经济性补贴导致美国市场车辆燃油经济性显著改善；全球溢出效应是一阶重要的——日本政策诱导的CO2减排大部分来自对美国汽车市场的影响；忽略属性传播的标准分析会严重低估政策效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统提出"属性传播"概念，为理解政策全球溢出效应提供新理论框架；揭示跨市场成本互补性作为属性传播的关键机制；拓展了政策评估的理论边界，将跨国企业的全球产品策略纳入分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供更全面的政策评估工具，避免低估政策效果；对全球环境、安全、反垄断和技术政策的评估具有重要启示；促进国际政策协调与合作。

detail.title: Diagnostic Expectations and the Macroeconomy

keywords: effect of sentiment on the economy

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2026-65
publicationDetails.journalName: Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We derive the theoretical predictions of diagnostic expectations regarding the transmission of sentiment to investment, employment, income, and consumption under imperfect information. We show and verify that, unlike rational expectations, diagnostic expectations predict short-term overreaction and subsequent reversals particularly in economies characterized by low financial sophistication. These effects are stronger when the macroeconomy is more uncertain and sentiment is less uncertain. Using several empirical measures of sentiment and macroeconomic uncertainty, we find evidence consistent with these predictions both in a cross-section of OECD countries and in US time-series data. Finally, we identify the transmission mechanism of expectations to the economy.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论上推导了诊断性预期（diagnostic expectations）如何在不完全信息下将情绪传导至投资、就业、收入和消费，发现与理性预期不同，诊断性预期在金融复杂度较低的经济体中预测短期过度反应和随后的反转，且在宏观经济更不确定、情绪更确定时效应更强。跨国和美国的时序数据为这些预测提供了实证支持。
AI.research_question: 在不完全信息下，诊断性预期如何传导情绪至实体经济（投资、就业、收入、消费）？其与理性预期的差异何在？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对情绪如何影响宏观经济知之甚少，尤其是现实中的预期形成方式（如诊断性预期）与传统理性预期的传导机制差异尚未得到系统检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 诊断性预期理论（diagnostic expectations），该理论认为人们对新信息的反应过度，因为人们倾向于根据最新信息更新信念，忽视基准概率。
AI.method: 理论推导+实证检验。使用多个情绪指标和宏观经济不确定性指标，对OECD跨国面板数据和美国时序数据进行回归分析。
AI.findings: （1）诊断性预期导致短期过度反应和随后的反转，尤其在金融复杂度低的经济体中更明显；（2）在宏观经济不确定性高、情绪不确定性低时效应更强；（3）OECD跨国数据和美国时序数据均支持上述预测。
AI.theory_contributions: 将诊断性预期理论系统应用于宏观经济学领域，揭示了非理性预期传导情绪的独特机制，拓展了行为宏观经济学的前沿。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者识别和应对情绪驱动的经济波动提供了理论依据，尤其对金融体系不发达的经济体具有重要参考价值。

detail.abstract: We identify a novel behavioral driver of environmental performance. An increase in country level consumer sentiment leads to sustained reduction in emission intensity over a multiyear horizon. Since consumer sentiment increases investment, productivity, energy efficiency, and stock market returns, a plausible explanation is that firms can afford to engage in costly reduction of emissions in a buoyant market. The effect tapers off over time and is stronger in countries where sentiment is a more reliable signal for the state of the economy. Our results suggest that policies boosting economic expectations yield substantial environmental benefits.

AI.tldr: 本文发现一国消费者情绪上升会在多年内持续降低排放强度，其机制是通过提振投资、生产率、能源效率和股市回报，使企业有能力在繁荣市场中承担减排成本。
AI.research_question: 消费者情绪这一行为驱动因素如何影响一国的环境绩效（排放强度）？
AI.motivation: 现有文献多以政策与技术视角解释环境绩效变化，而行为因素（如消费者情绪）对环境表现的驱动作用尚不明确。作者试图填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者情绪→投资/生产率/能源效率/股市回报↑→企业有能力进行昂贵的减排活动→排放强度↓
AI.method: 跨国面板数据分析，通过多国消费者情绪指数与排放强度数据进行实证回归，并考虑情绪信号可靠性的异质性。
AI.findings: 消费者情绪上升导致排放强度在多年内持续下降；该效应随时间衰减；在情绪能更可靠反映经济状况的国家中效应更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次识别消费者情绪作为环境绩效的行为驱动因素，拓展了环境经济学与行为经济学的交叉视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示政策制定者可通过提振经济预期（情绪）来获取环境效益，为情绪管理政策提供环境维度的支持。

detail.abstract: Data centers are the physical infrastructure behind cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and enterprise software. The rapid diffusion of artificial intelligence (AI) is intensifying demand for compute, accelerating investment in data centers, and raising concerns about the local economic and environmental footprint of these facilities. Their expansion creates a local policy tradeoff. A data center can bring capital investment, construction activity, and specialized employment, but it can also increase demand for electricity, land, and grid capacity. This paper studies these effects at the U.S. county level. We assemble a facility-level panel of global data centers with precise coordinates, scale metrics, and annualized revenue. We map facilities to U.S. counties and combine them with County Business Patterns, county-level IRS income, county-level house prices, and electricity prices. To address endogenous siting, we instrument for data center growth using two shift-share instruments, which leverage pre-existing proximity to InterTubes long-haul fiber nodes and the 1980 county share of U.S. urban college population as shares, and both Chinese and rest-of-the-world data center revenue growth as shifts. The IV estimates show positive effects on total employment, data-processing employment, construction employment, establishments, house prices, and electricity prices at different horizons after data center growth. We also find positive effects on tax returns, adjusted gross income, and wages, while annual payroll responds less robustly. The results suggest that data centers create measurable local activity, increase house prices, and affect local electricity markets through higher prices.

AI.tldr: 本文利用设施级全球数据中心面板数据，结合工具变量法，研究美国县级数据中心增长对当地就业、收入、房价和电价的影响，发现数据中心带来积极经济效应但推高房价和电价。
AI.research_question: 数据中心扩张对美国县级区域经济（就业、收入、房价）和环境（电价）有何影响？
AI.motivation: 人工智能快速发展加剧了对算力的需求，推动数据中心投资激增，但其对当地经济和环境的影响尚不明确，存在政策权衡——带来资本投入和就业的同时，也增加电力、土地和电网压力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区域经济增长理论、地方劳动力市场理论、基础设施外部性理论；利用shift-share工具变量解决数据中心选址的内生性问题。
AI.method: 构建全球数据中心设施级面板数据（含坐标、规模、年收入），匹配美国县级数据（County Business Patterns、IRS收入、房价、电价）。使用两个shift-share工具变量：基于InterTubes长距离光纤节点的邻近性和1980年县级城市大学生比例作为份额，中国和世界其他地区数据中心收入增长作为偏移量。
AI.findings: IV估计显示：数据中心增长对总就业、数据处理就业、建筑就业、企业数量、房价和电价均有正向影响；对纳税申报单数、调整后总收入、工资也有正向影响；但年薪总额响应较弱。数据中心创造了可测量的地方经济活动，但推高了房价和电价。
AI.theory_contributions: 为数字基础设施的地方经济效应提供了因果识别证据，补充了关于"数字工厂"对地方劳动力市场和住房市场影响的理论，揭示了数字经济基础设施建设中的政策权衡机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为地方政府制定数据中心招商引资政策提供实证依据：需权衡就业和经济增长收益与房价上涨、电价上升带来的居民生活成本增加的代价。
