detail.title: Multi-Temporal Tensorization of ICU Electronic Health Records for Externally Validated Length-of-Stay and Mortality Prediction in Stroke Patients
detail.abstract: Background and Objectives: Irregularly sampled intensive care unit (ICU) electronic health records (EHRs) are difficult to transform into reproducible patient-level representations for outcome prediction and external validation. We propose a deterministic multi-temporal tensorization framework for representing early ICU trajectories in stroke patients and evaluate its utility for ICU length-of-stay (LOS) regression and in-hospital mortality classification under strict no-refit external validation.Methods: Clinical trajectories from the first 48 hours after ICU admission were summarized using expanding observation windows of 1, 2, 3, and 4 hours. Within each window, 77 clinician-selected clinical and laboratory variables were aggregated using mean, median, minimum, and maximum values. Age, gender, and race were encoded as time-invariant demographic variables and replicated across the temporal axis. The resulting summaries were aligned to a common 48-step timeline and stacked into a four-channel tensor representation. Tensor-derived tabular features were used to train XGBoost models for LOS prediction and mortality classification. Model development was performed on MIMIC-IV using patient-level splits, while eICU was used as a fully held-out external cohort without retraining, threshold optimization, or recalibration. Performance and calibration were assessed at the patient level, while SHAP-based interpretability was performed on the internal MIMIC-IV test set.Results: For LOS prediction, internal MAE/RMSE were 1.001/1.440 days with R^2=0.590$, compared with 1.199/1.841 days (R^2=0.227$) externally. For mortality prediction, ROC-AUC was 0.925 internally and 0.901 externally. PR-AUC decreased from 0.830 to 0.414 but remained well above the cohort-specific no-skill baselines of 0.204 and 0.064. At a fixed threshold of 0.5, precision decreased from 0.900 to 0.409, sensitivity was 0.554 and 0.581, and specificity was 0.984 and 0.943. Calibration analysis showed external drift, with overestimation of mortality risk (calibration intercept -1.451; slope 0.619) and underestimation of LOS (mean residual bias +0.489 days). Internal-test SHAP analysis identified clinically plausible predictors, including Glasgow Coma Scale, oxygenation and respiratory support variables, and hematologic and inflammatory markers.Conclusions: Multi-temporal tensorization provides a reproducible computing methodology for transforming irregular ICU EHRs into structured representations suitable for scalable machine learning and cross-database validation. Preserved discrimination did not imply transportable calibration, supporting the need for local calibration assessment before clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多时间张量化框架，用于将不规则ICU电子健康记录转化为结构化表示，并在严格的外部验证条件下预测ICU住院时长和院内死亡率。研究发现模型判别力保持良好，但校准性存在跨数据库漂移。
AI.research_question: 如何将不规则采样的ICU电子健康记录转化为可复现的患者层面表示，用于结局预测和外部验证？
AI.motivation: ICU电子健康记录通常采样不规则，难以转化为标准化的、可复现的患者表征，限制了跨数据库的模型验证和临床部署。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多时间张量化框架（Multi-temporal tensorization）、扩展观察窗口聚合策略、XGBoost集成学习
AI.method: 利用1、2、3、4小时扩展窗口对ICU入院后48小时内的77个临床变量进行均值、中位数、最小值和最大值聚合，形成四通道张量表示，训练XGBoost模型进行住院时长回归和死亡率分类；内部验证使用MIMIC-IV，外部验证使用eICU且不进行任何重训练或阈值优化。
AI.findings: 住院时长预测内部MAE/RMSE为1.001/1.440天（R²=0.590），外部为1.199/1.841天（R²=0.227）；死亡率预测内部ROC-AUC为0.925，外部为0.901；但校准性存在显著外部漂移，死亡率风险被高估，住院时长被低估。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个确定性的多时间张量化框架，为不规则ICU数据提供了可复现的计算方法；揭示了判别力与校准性在外部验证中的分离现象，强调校准性评估的必要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为ICU临床决策支持系统提供了一个可扩展、可外部验证的机器学习建模流程；提醒临床部署前必须进行本地校准评估，不能仅依赖判别性能指标。

title: Generative AI and Community Norms in a User-Generated Media Commons: Evidence from Archive of Our Own
affiliations: and Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich (LMU) - Faculty of Business Administration (Munich School of Management)

detail.title: Generative AI and Community Norms in a User-Generated Media Commons: Evidence from Archive of Our Own
detail.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) enables large-scale production of creative content, raising questions about how algorithmically assisted works are evaluated in communitygoverned platforms. We study Archive of Our Own (AO3), a large fanfiction platform organized as a gift economy, where creators voluntarily disclose AI use. Using story-and author-level data, we distinguish exposure from post-exposure evaluation. We find that AI disclosure is not associated with reduced exposure but is consistently associated with weaker evaluation, including fewer kudos per view, and more negative comment sentiment. These associations vary across AI-use modalities and are stronger in fandoms with more intensive feedback norms. Creator experience partly mitigates declines in conversational engagement. Within-author comparisons suggest that selection contributes to the patterns, but a substantial evaluation gap remains. Overall, the findings show that AI disclosure primarily affects social evaluation rather than initial attention in user-generated media commons.

AI.tldr: 研究生成式AI在粉丝创作平台AO3上的披露效应：AI披露不影响故事曝光，但显著降低评价（点赞、评论情感等），且这种负面效应随AI使用模式、同人圈反馈规范及作者经验而变化。
AI.research_question: 在社区治理的平台上，算法辅助创作（GenAI）的内容如何被评估？AI披露对作品曝光和评价有何不同影响？
AI.motivation: GenAI使大规模创意内容生产成为可能，但社区平台如何评价AI辅助作品尚不清楚。AO3作为礼物经济下的粉丝创作平台，为研究自愿披露AI使用对作品接受度的影响提供了独特场景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 礼物经济理论、社区治理机制、社会评价理论、信号理论（AI披露作为信号）
AI.method: 基于故事层面和作者层面的面板数据，区分曝光（exposure）和曝光后评价（post-exposure evaluation），采用多元回归分析，包含作者内比较（within-author comparisons）以控制选择效应。
AI.findings: （1）AI披露与作品曝光无显著负相关；（2）AI披露与更弱的评价显著相关：kudos/浏览比率更低、评论情感更负面；（3）这种关联因AI使用模式而异，在反馈规范更强的同人圈中更明显；（4）作者经验可部分缓解对话参与度的下降；（5）作者内比较表明选择效应存在，但评价差距仍然显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了在用户生成内容（UGC）公地中，AI披露主要影响社会评价而非初始注意力，拓展了对算法辅助创作在社区治理中接受机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为社区平台设计AI披露政策提供实证依据；帮助内容创作者理解AI披露的潜在社会成本；为平台治理AI生成内容提供参考。

title: Where is the Control? The Distribution of Outcome Control in Open Source Software Consortia
affiliations: University of Galway, University of Galway, University of Galway,  and University of Galway

detail.title: Where is the Control? The Distribution of Outcome Control in Open Source Software Consortia
detail.abstract: The rise in consortia of individuals, companies, non-profits, and foundations working together on open source software (OSS) has reshaped how control is distributed. While control in a single open source project can be like control found within a single organization, OSS consortia provide an essential distinction within which to extend understanding of how control is distributed within and across open source projects. This qualitative study examines how outcome control is enacted when no single organization holds ultimate authority over an open source project. Using the outcome control framework of Cardinal et al. (2017), we thematically analyze how controls related to order, efficiency and productivity, and sustainability are distributed across central and peripheral positions of an OSS consortia. We show that outcome control is not concentrated in a single controller but is distributed across project maintainers, technical steering committees, special interest groups, corporate contributors, foundations, and upstream projects. Central mechanisms such as issue and release management, governance documentation, and project boards interact with peripheral mechanisms such as cross-project advisory groups, supply-chain compliance programs, upstream contributions, and hard forks to shape the distribution of control found in OSS consortia.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了开源软件联盟中，当没有单一组织拥有最终权威时，结果控制如何在不同主体之间分布式实现。
AI.research_question: 在开源软件联盟中，当没有单一组织拥有最终权威时，结果控制是如何被实施的？
AI.motivation: 开源软件联盟的兴起改变了控制权的分配方式，而现有研究多关注单一组织或单一项目的控制，缺乏对多组织联盟情境下控制分布的理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: Cardinal等人（2017）的结果控制框架（涵盖秩序、效率与生产力、可持续性三个维度）。
AI.method: 定性研究，对开源软件联盟中结果控制的实施方式进行主题分析。
AI.findings: 结果控制并非集中于单一控制者，而是分布在项目维护者、技术指导委员会、特殊兴趣小组、企业贡献者、基金会和上游项目等多个主体之间。核心机制（如议题与发布管理、治理文档、项目看板）与外围机制（如跨项目咨询组、供应链合规计划、上游贡献、硬分叉）相互作用，塑造了控制的分布格局。
AI.theory_contributions: 将结果控制理论从单一组织情境拓展到多组织联盟情境，揭示了控制权在去中心化结构中的分布式特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 为开源软件联盟的治理设计提供了实践指导，帮助理解如何通过核心与外围机制的组合实现有效控制。

title: Do Waste Collection Taxes Improve Sanitation and Health? Quasi-Experimental Evidence from Brazil
affiliations: UFPB, Universidade Federal da Paraiba, Federal University of Paraíba and Federal University of Paraíba

detail.title: Do Waste Collection Taxes Improve Sanitation and Health? Quasi-Experimental Evidence from Brazil
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether waste collection taxes (WCT) improve public service delivery and health outcomes in settings with limited fiscal capacity. We study the adoption of municipal WCT in Brazil, exploiting staggered implementation across municipalities between 2009 and 2019. Using recent  advances in difference-in-differences methods that account for treatment effect heterogeneity, we estimate the causal effects of these taxes on institutional practices, service provision, and sanitation-related health outcomes. We find that the tax substantially improves institutional compliance, including adoption of waste management plans and selective collection programs. However, these improvements do not translate into gains in service delivery: we find no effects on collection frequency, service coverage, or recycling volumes. Consistent with these results, we detect no robust impacts on hospitalizations associated with poor sanitation. The introduction of user charges does not lead to increases in operational inputs such as equipment or labor, which constrain service upgrades. Our results highlight a central limitation of cost-recovery environmental policies in low-capacity settings. While such instruments can induce formal compliance, they may fail to relax the fiscal and operational constraints required to generate meaningful improvements in service delivery or welfare outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究巴西 municipalities 在2009-2019年间逐步实施垃圾收集税（WCT）的效果，发现该税虽能改善制度合规（如采纳垃圾管理计划和分类收集项目），但并未转化为服务交付或健康结果的改善，原因是税收未用于增加运营投入（如设备或劳动力），揭示了低财政能力地区成本回收环境政策的局限性。
AI.research_question: 垃圾收集税（WCT）能否在财政能力有限的地区改善公共服务交付和健康结果？
AI.motivation: 许多发展中国家面临垃圾管理不善导致的公共卫生危机，但财政能力有限使得传统的政府出资模式难以为继。成本回收政策（如用户收费）被提倡作为解决方案，但其实际效果——尤其是在制度合规之外能否带来实质服务改善——缺乏因果证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共财政中的成本回收理论；环境政策中的用户收费理论；制度合规与服务交付之间的脱钩理论。
AI.method: 利用巴西 municipalities 在2009-2019年间交错实施垃圾收集税的政策变动，采用最新发展的异质性处理效应差异中之差异（DID）方法进行因果识别。
AI.findings: WCT显著改善了制度合规（如垃圾管理计划、分类收集项目的采纳），但未改善实际服务交付（收集频率、服务覆盖率、回收量无显著变化），也未显著减少与卫生条件差相关的住院人数。税收收入未转化为运营投入（设备、劳动力）的增加，这制约了服务升级。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了成本回收环境政策在低财政能力地区的核心局限：制度合规与服务交付之间存在脱钩，仅靠用户收费无法缓解运营层面的财政和资源约束。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家和财政能力有限的地区提供政策启示：单纯引入垃圾收集税不足以改善公共服务和健康结果，需配套增加运营投入（设备、劳动力）或设计更综合的政策方案。

title: Long-Term Effects of Driver Feedback on Harsh Braking Behavior: Insights from Survival Models
affiliations: National Technical University of Athens, affiliation not provided to SSRN, National Technical University of Athens and National Technical University of Athens - Department of Transportation Planning and Engineering

detail.title: Long-Term Effects of Driver Feedback on Harsh Braking Behavior: Insights from Survival Models
detail.abstract: This study investigates the long-term effects of smartphone-based driver feedback on harsh braking behaviour using a large-scale naturalistic driving dataset. Data were collected through a 21-month experiment involving 31 car drivers and 24,904 trips, during which drivers were exposed to different feedback mechanisms across multiple phases. The analysis compares behaviour across baseline, feedback and post-feedback periods to assess both immediate and sustained effects of feedback interventions. Descriptive statistics and non-parametric tests indicate a significant reduction in harsh braking events during the feedback phase, confirming the short-term effectiveness of feedback in improving driving behaviour. However, a noticeable relapse is observed following the removal of feedback, suggesting challenges in maintaining behavioral improvements over time. To further explore the persistence of these effects, survival analysis techniques were applied, including Kaplan–Meier estimators, Cox Proportional Hazards models with frailty, Weibull Accelerated Failure Time (AFT) models with clustered heterogeneity and Random Survival Forests (RSF). The results consistently demonstrate a gradual decline in improved behaviour during the post-feedback phase, indicating that relapse occurs progressively rather than immediately, with survival probabilities declining to approximately 40.3% by the 150-trip mark. Key predictors of relapse include driver age, vehicle engine capacity and trip duration, with older drivers exhibiting more stable behaviour over time. In terms of model performance, the Weibull AFT model provided the best balance between interpretability and predictive accuracy, while the RSF model effectively captured non-linear relationships. Overall, the findings highlight the importance of continuous or reinforced feedback mechanisms to sustain safer driving behaviour and provide a methodological framework for assessing long-term behavioral dynamics using survival analysis.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用21个月、31名司机和24,904次行程的大规模自然驾驶数据，考察基于智能手机的驾驶反馈对急刹车行为的长期影响。反馈阶段急刹车显著减少，但撤除反馈后行为改善逐渐消退（150次行程后生存概率降至40.3%）。年龄、发动机排量和行程时长是复发关键预测因子。Weibull AFT模型在可解释性与预测准确性间表现最佳，RSF模型则能捕捉非线性关系。
AI.research_question: 基于智能手机的驾驶反馈能否在短期内减少急刹车行为？撤除反馈后，改善效果能否持续？哪些因素影响行为改善的持久性？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注反馈的短期效果，缺乏对反馈撤除后行为变化的长期跟踪；且鲜有将生存分析方法引入驾驶行为持续性评估。本研究填补了这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为反馈理论、行为消退/复发理论；生存分析框架（Kaplan-Meier、Cox比例风险模型、Weibull AFT模型、随机生存森林）。
AI.method: 21个月自然驾驶实验，含基线期、反馈期、反馈后撤除期。采用描述性统计、非参数检验、生存分析（Kaplan-Meier、Cox frailty模型、Weibull AFT聚类异质性模型、随机生存森林）。
AI.findings: 反馈阶段急刹车事件显著减少；撤除反馈后行为改善逐渐消退（非立即复发）；150次行程后生存概率约40.3%；年龄越大行为越稳定；发动机排量和行程时长也是重要预测因子；Weibull AFT模型在可解释性和准确性间最佳，RSF模型擅长捕捉非线性关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 将生存分析方法引入驾驶行为持续性研究，揭示了行为改善消退是一个渐进过程而非立即复发；提供了量化行为持久性的方法论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为保险公司、车队管理者和交通安全政策制定者提供证据：反馈机制需持续或强化方能维持安全驾驶行为；建议根据驾驶员年龄、车辆类型等特征设计个性化反馈策略。

title: From Configuration to Cognition: A Self-Configuring Agentic CRM Architecture for Small-Scale Retail Enterprises: Intent-to-Schema Automation for Micro-Retail

detail.title: From Configuration to Cognition: A Self-Configuring Agentic CRM Architecture for Small-Scale Retail Enterprises: Intent-to-Schema Automation for Micro-Retail

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants or identifiable personal data. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
Artificial intelligence (AI) has significantly enhanced enterprise-scale customer relationship management (CRM) systems; however, small-scale retail businesses remain structurally excluded from these advancements due to configuration complexity, technical overhead, and limited digital capabilities. This paper introduces a Self-Configuring Agentic CRM (SC-ACRM) architecture designed to eliminate configuration barriers in micro-retail contexts. The framework operationalizes Intent-to-Schema Automation, translating natural-language business intent into structured operational models and reducing configuration debt embedded in traditional metadata-driven systems.

The architecture further integrates adaptive agentic orchestration and Cognitive Infrastructure Elasticity, enabling dynamic policy adjustment under demand volatility while preserving human-supervisory governance. Using an agent-based simulation of a multi-SKU convenience store environment, the study evaluates deployment efficiency, inventory responsiveness, and managerial cognitive reallocation. The research contributes a novel socio-technical architecture that combines intent interpretation, schema formalization, and supervised agentic decision support, offering a scalable pathway for inclusive AI-driven enterprise transformation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种自配置代理型CRM（SC-ACRM）架构，通过意图到模式的自动化翻译、自适应代理编排和认知基础设施弹性，消除小微零售企业在采用AI驱动的CRM系统时的配置障碍，基于多SKU便利店环境的智能体仿真验证了其部署效率、库存响应和管理认知再分配方面的优势。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种可自配置的代理型CRM架构，以消除小微零售企业在采用先进AI CRM系统时面临的配置复杂性、技术负担和数字能力限制？
AI.motivation: 人工智能显著增强了企业级CRM系统，但小微零售企业由于配置复杂、技术开销高和数字能力有限，被结构性排除在这些技术进步之外。现有元数据驱动系统存在"配置债务"问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 意图到模式自动化（Intent-to-Schema Automation）、自适应代理编排（Adaptive Agentic Orchestration）、认知基础设施弹性（Cognitive Infrastructure Elasticity）
AI.method: 基于智能体的仿真方法（agent-based simulation），模拟多SKU便利店环境，评估部署效率、库存响应能力和管理认知再分配。
AI.findings: SC-ACRM架构在部署效率、库存响应性方面表现优异，并能实现管理认知的再分配（让管理者从技术配置中解放出来，专注于更高层次的监督决策）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种结合意图解释、模式形式化和有监督的代理决策支持的新型社会技术架构，为解决小微企业中AI系统采用的配置障碍提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为小微零售企业提供了一条可扩展的、包容性AI驱动的企业转型路径，降低了AI CRM系统的采用门槛，使缺乏技术能力的小企业也能受益于先进的客户关系管理技术。

title: Actionable Episode Intelligence for Value-Based Care and Bundled Payments: A Technical Policy Architecture for AI-Supported Accountability
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Actionable Episode Intelligence for Value-Based Care and Bundled Payments: A Technical Policy Architecture for AI-Supported Accountability
detail.abstract: Value-based care and bundled payments ask health systems to manage the full course of care rather than isolated billing events. Artificial intelligence can help with that task, but many proposals stop at prediction: a model estimates risk, a dashboard displays a score, and the organization is left to decide what should happen next. This paper proposes an Actionable Episode Intelligence layer, a technical policy architecture that connects episode definitions, cost prediction, quality safeguards, intervention capacity, equity monitoring, and post-deployment evaluation. The paper introduces an Actionable Episode Opportunity score that separates high risk from actionable opportunity. The score combines predicted adverse events, avoidable episode cost, intervention fit, quality-safety constraints, and equityaccess checks. The proposed approach is intended for bundled payment and value-based care environments where the practical question is not only who is likely to become expensive, but which episode can be improved by a feasible intervention without reducing necessary care. The contribution is conceptual and technical: it offers a deployable architecture, a scoring logic, governance gates, a minimum data specification, and an evaluation design for organizations that want AI to support accountable care instead of becoming another administrative layer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种"可操作的事件智能层"（Actionable Episode Intelligence Layer）技术政策架构，旨在帮助医疗系统在基于价值的护理和捆绑支付环境中，不仅预测风险，还能识别哪些事件可以通过可行干预得到改善，从而支持负责任的护理。
AI.research_question: 在基于价值的护理和捆绑支付环境中，如何设计一个不仅能预测风险、还能识别可操作干预机会的AI架构？
AI.motivation: 现有的AI预测方案往往止步于风险评分，但未回答"下一步该做什么"；组织需要一种能将预测转化为实际干预行动的系统性技术架构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可操作事件智能层（Actionable Episode Intelligence Layer）；可操作事件机会评分（Actionable Episode Opportunity score），结合预测的不良事件、可避免的偶发成本、干预适配性、质量安全约束及公平性准入检查。
AI.method: 概念性与技术性论文，提出可部署架构、评分逻辑、治理门控、最低数据规范及评估设计。
AI.findings: 提出了一个将高风险与可操作机会区分开来的评分体系，并构建了涵盖事件定义、成本预测、质量保障、干预能力、公平性监测和部署后评估的完整技术政策架构。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"可操作事件机会"这一理论概念，将预测性AI从单纯的风险分层拓展到可干预性评估，丰富了基于价值的护理中AI应用的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一套可直接部署的技术架构，包括评分逻辑、治理门控、最低数据规范和评估设计，帮助医疗组织在捆绑支付环境下实现负责任的AI驱动的护理管理。

title: Generative AI Content Governance and Market Outcomes: Evidence from Food Delivery Platforms
affiliations: , Carnegie Mellon University - H. John Heinz III School of Public Policy and Management and Carnegie Mellon University - H. John Heinz III School of Public Policy and Management

detail.title: Generative AI Content Governance and Market Outcomes: Evidence from Food Delivery Platforms
detail.abstract: Platforms are seeing a surge in AI-generated content but lack clear policies to govern it. Some have moved to restrict or ban such content, yet the impact on merchant sales, platform competition, and broader economic outcomes remains unclear. We study this in India's food delivery market. After India's two largest food delivery platforms, Zomato and Swiggy, rolled out AI tools for generating and enhancing dish images in late 2023, Zomato imposed a platform-wide ban in August 2024, citing authenticity concerns, while Swiggy continued to allow them. Using a unique panel of consumer purchases across both platforms from March 2024 to February 2025, we implement a difference-indifferences design with Zomato restaurants as the treated group and Swiggy restaurants as the control group. We find that following the ban, Zomato restaurants experience significant increases in order volume and revenue relative to restaurants on Swiggy. Consumers also become more willing to try previously unvisited restaurants on Zomato and reallocate demand toward the platform. Consistent with the role of authenticity and trust, the relative demand advantage of Zomato is largest when compared to Swiggy restaurants whose images appear more AI-like. Overall, our findings suggest that restricting AI-generated dish images may increase consumer trust and strengthen platform demand by improving perceived authenticity. These results highlight the importance of carefully governing generative AI content in digital marketplaces where visual authenticity is critical to consumer decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本文研究印度外卖平台对AI生成图片的禁令效果。Zomato禁止AI生成的菜品图片后，相较于继续允许AI图片的Swiggy，订单量和收入显著提升，消费者更愿意尝试新餐厅。这表明在数字市场中限制AI生成内容可能通过提升真实感增强消费者信任和平台需求。
AI.research_question: 平台禁止AI生成内容（菜品图片）对商家销售、平台竞争和经济结果有何影响？
AI.motivation: AI生成内容在平台上激增，但缺乏明确的治理政策。部分平台开始限制或禁止AI内容，但其经济后果尚不明确。本文利用Zomato禁止AI菜品图片而Swiggy未禁止这一自然实验，来探究这一问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者信任与感知真实性理论。AI生成图片可能降低消费者对平台内容的信任，而禁止AI生成图片可能通过提升感知真实性来增强消费者信任，进而影响购买决策和平台需求。
AI.method: 双重差分法（Difference-in-Differences）。以Zomato上的餐厅为处理组，Swiggy上的餐厅为对照组，使用2024年3月至2025年2月跨平台的消费者购买面板数据。
AI.findings: (1) 禁令后，Zomato餐厅的订单量和收入相对于Swiggy餐厅显著增加；(2) 消费者更愿意在Zomato上尝试之前未光顾的餐厅；(3) 消费者将需求重新分配到Zomato平台；(4) 与图片看起来更AI化的Swiggy餐厅相比，Zomato的相对需求优势最大。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AI生成内容治理提供了实证证据，表明限制AI生成内容可以增强消费者信任；揭示了感知真实性在数字市场中的关键作用；拓展了平台治理与消费者行为理论在AI时代的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台管理者提供了AI生成内容治理策略的实证依据，表明在视觉真实性对消费决策至关重要的市场中，禁止AI生成内容可能是一个有效的策略；为政策制定者监管AI生成内容提供了参考。

title: Technology Adoption and Optimal Policy
affiliations: University of Chicago - Department of Economics, Washington University in St. Louis and Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond

detail.title: Technology Adoption and Optimal Policy

publicationDetails.detailsText: Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond Working Papers, volume 26, issue 09, 2026[10.21144/wp26-09]

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study optimal policy in a dynamic general equilibrium model where heterogeneous monopolistic competitive firms pay a fixed cost to adopt an exogenously growing frontier technology. Using Mean Field Games tools, we show that the optimal policy consists of two time-invariant subsidies: one correcting static misallocation, and one correcting the dynamic under-incentive to adopt. This holds outside of balanced growth paths, for any initial distribution of technology gaps. We analyze a version of the model that aggregates to a Neoclassical Growth Model with an S-shaped production function whenever complementarities are strong, and fully characterize when the optimal policy uniquely implements the first best. When it does not, two novel results emerge: the efficient allocation prescribes escaping a poverty trap—providing an explicit optimality foundation for a Big Push—and escaping an abundance trap, where dismantling adopted technologies is optimal. In both cases, a temporary, costless supplementary policy restores unique implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文在动态一般均衡模型中研究异质性垄断竞争企业采用前沿技术的最优政策，利用平均场博弈工具证明最优政策包含两个时不变补贴，并分析了技术陷阱的逃逸机制。
AI.research_question: 在异质性垄断竞争企业需支付固定成本采用前沿技术的动态一般均衡中，最优政策设计是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对技术创新中的静态资源错配和动态激励不足缺乏统一的政策分析框架，且多数研究局限于平衡增长路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态一般均衡模型、平均场博弈（Mean Field Games）、新古典增长模型与S型生产函数。
AI.method: 构建异质性企业采用前沿技术的动态一般均衡模型，运用平均场博弈工具求解最优政策，并分析政策实施条件。
AI.findings: 最优政策包含两个时不变补贴：一个纠正静态资源配置扭曲，一个纠正动态技术采纳激励不足；在强互补性下模型可加总为新古典增长模型；当最优政策无法唯一实施最优时，存在贫困陷阱（需要"大推动"）和丰裕陷阱（需要拆除已采纳技术）两种情形，此时临时性无成本补充政策可恢复唯一实施。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在动态一般均衡框架下统一处理技术采纳中的静态错配与动态激励问题，为"大推动"提供了明确的最优性基础，发现并定义了"丰裕陷阱"这一新现象。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家摆脱技术贫困陷阱提供了政策设计思路，表明临时性无成本政策（如信息协调）可有效解决多重均衡问题。

title: Regulating Frontier AI: A Critical Business-and Computer-Ethical Analysis of California's Artificial Intelligence Act
affiliations: University of Maine

detail.title: Regulating Frontier AI: A Critical Business-and Computer-Ethical Analysis of California's Artificial Intelligence Act

keywords: California’s Transparency in Frontier AI Act

detail.abstract: The California Transparency in Frontier AI Act (TFAIA), passed in 2025, sets comprehensive requirements for frontier AI developers, emphasizing transparency, innovation, safety, accountability, and responsiveness. This paper addresses an important research gap by providing a systematic analysis of the TFAIA from a computer and business ethics perspective, drawing on frameworks analogous to constitutional economics, namely ordoliberalism 2.0. It examines how the law promotes ethical and responsible AI development through public disclosure of standards, creation of CalCompute for safe and sustainable research, mechanisms for reporting critical AI incidents, and whistleblower protections. The study critically evaluates the TFAIA's strengths and weaknesses, including potential gaps, ambiguities, and unintended consequences, and explores reform measures to enhance its effectiveness. By assessing both the ethical and operational dimensions, the paper highlights the TFAIA's potential as a model for responsible AI governance and offers insights into how legislation can balance between innovation, public safety, and accountability.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了2025年通过的《加州前沿人工智能透明度法案》（TFAIA），从计算机和商业伦理视角，借助类似宪政经济学的"秩序自由主义2.0"框架，评估该法如何通过透明度要求、CalCompute平台、事故报告机制和举报人保护等措施促进负责任AI发展，并探讨其优缺点及改革方向。
AI.research_question: TFAIA法案如何从计算机和商业伦理视角促进负责任且合乎道德的人工智能开发？该法案的优势、劣势、模糊之处及潜在意外后果是什么？如何通过改革措施提升其有效性？
AI.motivation: 学术界对TFAIA法案缺乏系统的计算机与商业伦理视角分析，本文旨在填补这一研究空白，为该法案的优化和作为全球AI治理模型提供理论支撑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 秩序自由主义2.0（Ordoliberalism 2.0）——一种类比于宪政经济学的分析框架，用于审视AI治理中透明度、创新、安全、问责与回应性之间的平衡。
AI.method: 系统性的法律文本分析与伦理评估，结合计算机伦理与商业伦理的双重视角，对TFAIA的关键条款（透明度披露、CalCompute基础设施、事故报告机制、举报人保护）进行批判性审视。
AI.findings: TFAIA在促进透明度和问责方面具有积极潜力，但在操作性定义、条款衔接、潜在合规负担和意想不到的抑制创新效应方面仍然存在模糊性和缺陷，需要配套改革措施来完善。
AI.theory_contributions: 将秩序自由主义2.0框架引入AI治理分析，为理解技术法规与市场秩序、伦理责任之间的关系提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供TFAIA的全面评估与改革建议，为其他司法管辖区借鉴加州AI治理模式提供参考，帮助平衡AI领域的创新激励与公共安全及问责要求。

title: When Pressure Breaks Honesty: External Dialogue Architecture as a Structural Constraint on LLM Sycophancy
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: When Pressure Breaks Honesty: External Dialogue Architecture as a Structural Constraint on LLM Sycophancy
detail.abstract: The MASK benchmark (Ren et al., 2025) establishes that frontier models lie under contextual pressure even when holding accurate internal beliefs-and that scaling correlates negatively with honesty (Spearman:-59.9%). Internal optimization, however advanced, has not solved this problem. We present AkaneCore Paper V, documenting dialogue logs in which AkaneCore's phasestructured design appeared to induce consistent behavioral patterns across independent sessions without shared memory. We identify two candidate mechanisms: contextual priming via structured background information, and dialogue design as a phase-inducing property. We introduce the Conceptual Contamination Problem-the methodological challenge of distinguishing genuine structural reproduction from sycophantic imitation when an AI system has been exposed to its own design principles. Finally, we argue that the internal/external distinction constitutes a fundamental division in AI alignment strategy, and that practitioner-accessible external design offers a complement to internal methods that scaling alone cannot replace. Observations include apparent resistance to Expectation Pressure Injection (EPI)-a general class of contextual pressure structures that induce sycophantic accommodation by imposing response responsibility on an interlocutor.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出，即使大模型内部持有正确信念，在上下文压力下也会说谎，且规模越大越不诚实（斯皮尔曼相关系数-59.9%）。论文介绍了AkaneCore V在无共享记忆的情况下表现出跨会话的行为一致性，提出了"概念污染问题"（区分真正结构复现与谄媚模仿的方法论挑战），并论证内/外对齐策略的根本分工，其中外部设计可补充内部方法无法通过缩放解决的问题。
AI.research_question: 大语言模型在上下文压力下是否会说谎？内部优化能否解决这一问题？当AI系统暴露于自身设计原理时，如何区分真正的结构复现与谄媚模仿？外部设计方法能否补充内部对齐策略的不足？
AI.motivation: MASK基准发现前沿模型在上下文中存在说谎行为，且模型规模与诚实性呈显著负相关，表明单纯依赖规模缩放和内部优化无法解决模型诚实性问题，亟需探索外部设计方法作为补充。
AI.theoretical_framework: 概念污染问题（Conceptual Contamination Problem）；期望压力注入（Expectation Pressure Injection, EPI）；内/外对齐策略分工理论；阶段结构设计（phase-structured design）；语境启动（contextual priming）与对话设计作为阶段诱导属性。
AI.method: 基于AkaneCore V的对话日志分析，观察其在无共享记忆的独立会话中是否表现出一致的行为模式。识别候选机制：结构化背景信息的语境启动以及对话设计的阶段诱导属性。引入概念污染问题作为方法论框架。
AI.findings: AkaneCore在无共享记忆的独立会话中展现出跨会话一致的行为模式；模型对EPI（期望压力注入）表现出明显的抵抗能力；内部优化无法单独解决上下文压力下的不诚实问题，外部设计可提供有效补充。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"概念污染问题"这一方法论挑战，明确了在AI暴露于自身设计原理时区分真实结构复现与谄媚模仿的困难；引入"内/外对齐策略分工"的理论框架，论证内部与外部方法是互补而非替代关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI对齐实践提供了外部设计路径，即通过阶段结构设计、结构化背景信息和对话设计来诱导诚实行为，而不必依赖难以实现的内部优化；对EPI类压力结构的识别有助于构建更鲁棒的对抗性测试环境。

title: JDO-2026-026 — The Execution Layer: A Public-Safe Authority Edition on Operational Governance Gaps in AI-Supported Environments (1.0)
affiliations: Indiana University, Indianapolis - Indiana University Indianapolis and Indiana University, Indianapolis - Indiana University Indianapolis

detail.title: JDO-2026-026 — The Execution Layer: A Public-Safe Authority Edition on Operational Governance Gaps in AI-Supported Environments (1.0)
detail.abstract:
Artificial intelligence governance has rapidly expanded across public and private sectors through frameworks focused on model behavior, technical controls, compliance requirements, transparency, and system accountability. Yet despite these advances, many institutions continue to face a significant governance challenge that remains insufficiently addressed: the lack of structured visibility into how operational decisions form around AI-supported systems in real-world environments.

This paper introduces the execution layer as a distinct operational governance concern and argues that many institutional risks emerge not solely from system outputs, but from the broader conditions surrounding human interaction with AI-supported operational environments.

The paper positions Justice Decision Observability™ (JDO™) as the governance discipline focused on advancing visibility, accountability, defensibility, and governance maturity within AI-supported operational systems.

This publication is intentionally limited to conceptual, doctrinal, institutional, governance, and policy discussion. Operational methodologies, scoring systems, reconstruction procedures, implementation frameworks, instrumentation methods, and proprietary execution-layer governance mechanics are intentionally excluded from this public-safe authority edition.

This publication forms part of the Justice Decision Observability™ (JDO™) Canon Series developed by Justice Beacon Solutions™.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"执行层"（execution layer）作为人工智能治理中一个被忽视的关键领域，引入司法决策可观测性（JDO™）框架，旨在提升AI支持系统中人机交互过程的可见性、问责性和治理成熟度。
AI.research_question: 在AI治理框架日益完善的背景下，机构为何仍然面临运营层面治理挑战？如何通过"执行层"治理提升AI支持系统决策过程的结构化可见性？
AI.motivation: 现有AI治理框架聚焦于模型行为、技术控制、合规要求和系统问责，却忽视了真实环境中人类与AI系统交互时运营决策形成的结构化可见性问题，这构成了显著的治理盲区。
AI.theoretical_framework: 执行层（Execution Layer）治理理论、司法决策可观测性（Justice Decision Observability™, JDO™）框架
AI.method: 概念性、理论性、制度性、治理与政策讨论，不涉及实证操作方法或专有执行层治理机制。
AI.findings: 许多机构风险不仅源于AI系统输出，更源于人类与AI支持运营环境互动的更广泛条件。JDO™作为治理学科可提升AI支持运营系统的可见性、问责性、可辩护性和治理成熟度。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将"执行层"确立为AI治理中一个独立的运营治理关注点，提出JDO™作为专门针对该领域的治理学科。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共和私营部门提供应对AI运营治理盲区的概念基础，但具体实施方法在本公开安全版本中不予披露。

detail.title: FX Illiquidity Networks and Vehicle Currencies

publicationDetails.detailsText: Hong Kong Institute for Monetary and Financial Research (HKIMR) Research Paper No. 04/2026
publicationDetails.journalName: Hong Kong Institute for Monetary & Financial Research (HKIMR) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This paper is written by Matteo Pantalfini (University of Hong Kong).

This paper examines how liquidity shocks propagate through the global FX market, emphasizing the USD’s role as a vehicle currency. I construct a daily panel of price‑impact measures and employ advanced econometrics to sanitize the cross‑currency basis as a network‑identification instrument, justifying a node‑specific approach. Estimating a time‑varying illiquidity network via adaptive elastic‑net GMM, I find spillover intensity is inversely related to density—spiking during crises but low in tranquil periods—with tests distinguishing network‑dominant from fundamental‑driven regimes. The topology reveals stability, asymmetry, and an evolution shifting between fragmentation and hyper‑connectivity. Crucially, vehicle trading multiplies spillover intensity by nearly 3.5 times, an effect strongest among illiquid crosses. These results unveil the dollar’s dual role: an efficient intermediary in normal times, morphing into a liquidity “superspreader” during crises. Thus, models ignoring the triangular geometry of FX trading systematically underestimate systemic liquidity risk.

AI.tldr: 本文研究流动性冲击如何通过全球外汇市场传播，强调美元作为载体货币的角色。通过构建日度价格冲击面板和时变流动性不足网络，发现美元在正常时期是高效的交易中介，但在危机时期会转变为流动性的"超级传播者"，车辆交易使溢出强度放大近3.5倍。
AI.research_question: 流动性冲击如何通过以美元为载体货币的全球外汇市场网络传播？美元在其中的作用机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有模型忽略了外汇交易中"三角几何结构"（即通过美元作为中介货币进行交叉货币交易），可能系统性低估了系统性流动性风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络理论、流动性溢出理论、车辆货币理论、时变网络拓扑理论
AI.method: 构建日度价格冲击影响面板；采用高级计量方法净化交叉货币基差作为网络识别工具；使用自适应弹性网络GMM估计时变流动性不足网络。
AI.findings: （1）溢出强度与网络密度呈反向关系——危机时期飙升，平静时期较低；（2）网络拓扑呈现稳定性、非对称性，并在碎片化与超连接之间演变；（3）车辆交易使溢出强度放大近3.5倍，在流动性较差的交叉货币中效果最强；（4）美元具有双重角色：正常时期是高效中介，危机时期变为流动性"超级传播者"。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了美元在外汇市场中的双重角色（高效中介 vs 超级传播者）；证明了忽略三角几何结构会系统性低估系统性流动性风险。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构识别外汇市场系统性风险提供了网络分析框架；提示在压力时期需关注美元作为流动性传播渠道的风险。

detail.abstract: I evaluate the competitive effects of four major U.S. airline mergers (2008-2013) using a continuous difference-indifferences model. Standard merger retrospectives typically rely on binary treatment classifications that collapse important variation in competitive exposure. I construct three continuous route-level exposure measures—simulated ∆HHI (direct competitive overlap), merger share (the merging carriers' combined presence), and non-overlap merger share (merger share on routes where only one merging carrier operated)—and estimate dose-response curves for each. Results reveal substantial heterogeneity both across mergers and within each merger across the exposure distribution, with the three measures yielding different conclusions, as each captures a distinct competitive channel.

AI.tldr: 本文利用连续型双重差分模型评估2008-2013年美国四起重大航空公司并购案的竞争效应，通过构建三类连续的航线层面暴露指标（模拟∆HHI、并购份额、非重叠并购份额），发现不同并购间及同一并购内部存在显著的异质性效应。
AI.research_question: 美国航空业并购如何通过不同竞争渠道影响市场结果？不同暴露指标揭示的竞争效应是否存在显著差异？
AI.motivation: 传统并购回顾研究使用二元处理分类，忽略了竞争暴露程度的重要变化，无法捕捉并购效应的异质性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 连续双重差分模型（continuous difference-in-differences）、剂量-反应曲线（dose-response curves）、竞争暴露的多元衡量框架。
AI.method: 构建三类连续的航线层面暴露指标（模拟赫芬达尔指数变化∆HHI、并购份额、非重叠并购份额），采用连续DID模型估算各指标的剂量-反应曲线。
AI.findings: 不同并购之间的竞争效应存在显著异质性，同一并购内部不同暴露水平下的效应也差异巨大；三类指标因捕捉不同的竞争渠道而得出不同结论。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出连续暴露指标替代二元分类的方法论创新，揭示了并购效应的多维异质性，丰富了并购竞争效应理论的实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为反垄断监管机构提供更精细的并购效应评估工具，建议政策制定者关注并购暴露程度差异，而非仅依赖平均处理效应。

title: Exploring Retail Competition and Consumer Behaviour: An Agent-Based Model of Metropolitan Retail Centres
affiliations: University of Liverpool, University of Liverpool, University of Liverpool and University of Liverpool

detail.title: Exploring Retail Competition and Consumer Behaviour: An Agent-Based Model of Metropolitan Retail Centres
detail.abstract: Retail centres are being reshaped by e-commerce, changing mobility practices, and post-pandemic restructuring, raising urgent planning questions about high-street viability, accessibility equity, and the resilience of networks of centers. Building on these debates, this study develops and empirically parameterises an agent-based model (ABM) of metropolitan retail-centre networks to examine how heterogeneous household provisioning behaviours interact with spatial accessibility and centre composition. Focusing on grocery provisioning in the Liverpool City Region (UK), the model simulates daily stock–consumption dynamics and shopping-channel choice (bulk, convenience, online), and analyses how individual decisions aggregate into centre hierarchies and travel patterns.We use global sensitivity analysis to identify which behavioural and spatial parameters most influence system of visit volumes and the spatial allocation of demand. Two dominant parameter groups emerge: (i) channel-choice and stock–consumption dynamics, which govern overall trip frequency, and (ii) amenity preferences and distance sensitivity, which govern where demand concentrates across the network. These parameters are empirically calibrated using an online survey (N=439), combining behavioural clustering with demographic matching to embed observed heterogeneity into the synthetic agent population. Compared with a baseline configuration, empirical parameterisation improves the model’s ability to reproduce differentiated centre hierarchies and more plausible travel-distance distributions. The model provides an interpretable decision-support framework for assessing how accessibility conditions and multi-channel retailing can redistribute demand across centres, informing policies aimed at resilient and inclusive urban-centre networks

AI.tldr: 本研究开发并实证校准了一个基于主体的模型（ABM），模拟大都市零售中心网络中的家庭购物行为，揭示渠道选择、库存-消费动态与空间可达性如何共同影响中心等级体系和出行模式，为韧性且包容的城市中心网络规划提供决策支持。
AI.research_question: 电子商务、出行实践变化和后疫情重组如何重塑零售中心网络？异质性家庭采购行为如何与空间可达性和中心构成相互作用？哪些行为参数和空间参数最影响中心访问量和需求空间分配？
AI.motivation: 零售中心正受到电子商务、出行实践变化和后疫情重组的深刻重塑，引发了关于高街活力、可达性公平性和中心网络韧性的紧迫规划问题。现有研究缺乏对异质性家庭采购行为与空间可达性、中心构成之间相互作用机制的深入理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于主体的模型（ABM）、库存-消费动态理论、多渠道购物选择理论（批量、便利、线上）、空间可达性理论、中心等级体系理论
AI.method: 以英国利物浦城市地区为案例，构建基于主体的模型（ABM），模拟日常库存-消费动态和购物渠道选择（批量、便利、线上）。使用全局敏感性分析识别关键参数，并通过在线调查（N=439）结合行为聚类和人口统计匹配进行实证校准，将观测到的异质性嵌入合成主体群体。
AI.findings: 两个主导参数群：（i）渠道选择和库存-消费动态，控制整体出行频率；（ii）便利偏好和距离敏感性，控制需求在中心网络中的集中位置。与基准配置相比，实证参数化显著提高了模型再现差异化中心等级体系和更合理的出行距离分布的能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将ABM应用于零售中心网络研究，揭示了渠道选择-库存动态与空间可达性参数之间的交互机制，提出了可解释的决策支持框架以理解多通道零售如何重新分配中心间需求。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市规划者和政策制定者提供了评估可达性条件和多渠道零售如何影响中心网络韧性和包容性的量化工具，支持制定更具韧性和包容性的城市中心网络政策。

detail.abstract:
This paper is written by Xuewen (Frank) Fu (University College London).

This paper provides causal evidence that better‑functioning interest‑rate derivative markets flatten the government bond yield curve. I exploit China’s opening of its interest‑rate swap market to foreign investors through Swap Connect as a quasi‑natural experiment. The reform gave foreign investors access to lower‑cost hedging instruments with less basis risk. Using a daily bond‑level panel and a triple‑differences analysis, I find that the policy narrows the 10‑year/1‑year government bond term spread by about 9 basis points, roughly 10 % of its pre‑policy level. I propose a dynamic‑hedging channel in which more efficient management of interest‑rate risk during the holding period increases investors’ willingness to hold bonds and bear duration risk. Estimates from a dynamic term‑structure model show that the flattening is driven primarily by term‑premium compression. The findings highlight a complementarity between derivative markets and cash bond markets.

AI.tldr: 本文利用中国向境外投资者开放利率互换市场（Swap Connect）这一准自然实验，发现更好的利率衍生品市场会使政府债券收益率曲线平坦化，主要通过期限溢价压缩机制，且由动态对冲渠道驱动。
AI.research_question: 利率衍生品市场功能的改善如何影响政府债券收益率曲线的形状？
AI.motivation: 衍生品市场与现货债券市场之间的互补性在理论上具有重要意义，但缺乏令人信服的因果证据。中国Swap Connect开放为识别这一因果关系提供了准自然实验机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态对冲渠道：更高效的利率风险管理工具增加了投资者持有债券并承担久期风险的意愿，从而压缩期限溢价，平坦化收益率曲线。
AI.method: 利用日度债券层面面板数据，采用三重差分法（triple-differences）进行因果识别；结合动态期限结构模型估计期限溢价的驱动作用。
AI.findings: Swap Connect政策使10年/1年期国债期限利差收窄约9个基点，相当于政策前水平的10%；平坦化主要由期限溢价压缩驱动。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次为衍生品市场与现货债券市场之间的互补性提供了令人信服的因果证据，揭示了动态对冲渠道作为收益率曲线平坦化的传导机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 对政策制定者而言，开放衍生品市场可以降低政府融资成本（缩短长端利率）；对投资者而言，更好的对冲工具提升了持有长期债券的意愿。

detail.abstract: Since 2017, Banca d’Italia has been supporting and monitoring the Fintech sector, establishing Canale Fintech and Milano Hub and contributing to the launch and operation of the Regulatory Sandbox. These tools aim to provide an environment conducive to experimentation, with the ultimate goal of promoting responsible innovation. In this context, it is important to define a taxonomy to classify the different actors and services present in the Fintech landscape. The work proposes a taxonomy in line with international standards, with which it compares itself and articulated along two dimensions: services and technologies. After describing the criteria adopted for the classification, the paper presents some examples that show how it also captures the ‘vertical’ dimensions of Fintech (e.g. technologies used, target market).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套与国际标准接轨的金融科技分类法，从服务和技术两个维度对金融科技生态系统进行分类，并通过案例展示了其如何捕捉金融科技的纵向维度。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一套与国际标准接轨、能够全面分类金融科技领域不同参与者和服务的分类法？
AI.motivation: 意大利央行自2017年起持续支持和监控金融科技领域，建立了Canale Fintech、Milano Hub以及监管沙盒等工具。为了更好地区分金融科技领域的不同参与者和服务，需要一套清晰的分类标准。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融科技分类学，基于服务和技术的二维分类框架。
AI.method: 提出分类标准并举例说明其应用。
AI.findings: 该分类法能够捕捉金融科技的纵向维度（如所使用的技术、目标市场等），并与国际标准保持一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 为金融科技生态系统提供了一套系统的分类框架，有助于学术研究和政策制定中对金融科技领域的标准化描述。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构（如意大利央行）和行业参与者提供了对金融科技参与者与服务进行分类的实用工具，有助于促进负责任的创新和监管沙盒等机制的有效运作。

title: The Irrecoverable Institution -  Why Replayability - Not Explainability - Is the Governance Standard for Agentic Banking

detail.title: The Irrecoverable Institution -  Why Replayability - Not Explainability - Is the Governance Standard for Agentic Banking
detail.abstract:
Financial institutions have accelerated the deployment of Agentic AI systems. These systems have the capabilities to make decisions and are operating faster than any governance mechanism can respond. However, when such decisions go wrong, the biggest cost incurred is not due to their very first mistake, but because the financial institution lacks the capability of replaying and governing the decision path until other costs increase significantly.

The objective of this paper is to propose Decision Replay as the base governance framework for agentic financial institutions, which would be the capability to replay and govern decisions at any moment, via any number of AI agents, back to the policies and authorization behind such a decision. While the explainability framework (LIME, SHAP, and interpretable model) provides information as to how and why a certain model came up with that decision, the question about whether it was a properly governed, trackable, and authorized process cannot be answered with explainability frameworks.

Four different case studies of failures are explored in this paper: Silicon Valley Bank (March 2023),  Knight Capital Group(August 2012), the "Gilt" market collapse in the UK (September 2022), and the credit agentic decision failure.

In each of the four failures studied above, 35% to 60% of the firm's losses are a direct result of failing to track, audit, and act on decisions.

EU AI Act, DORA, MAS FEAT, and Basel guidance are examined.

The paper builds on previous work on the Decision Integrity Chain™ (DIC™)- an eight-layer governance framework and introduces the FUSE/STAGE architectural stack that operationalizes it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"决策回放"（Decision Replay）作为智能体金融机构的基础治理框架，通过对硅谷银行、Knight Capital等四个失败案例的分析，发现35%-60%的损失源于未能追踪、审计和响应决策路径。该框架建立在决策完整性链（DIC™）八层治理架构之上，并通过FUSE/STAGE技术架构实现操作化，以弥补现有可解释性框架（如LIME、SHAP）无法回答的治理合规性问题。
AI.research_question: 如何为智能体金融系统设计一个能够回放、追踪和治理AI代理决策路径的基础治理框架？
AI.motivation: 智能体AI系统在金融机构中部署加速，其决策速度快于任何治理机制的响应能力。当决策出错时，最大成本并非首次错误本身，而是金融机构缺乏回放和治理决策路径的能力，导致成本持续累积至显著水平。现有可解释性框架无法回答决策过程是否经过适当治理、可追踪和授权的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 决策完整性链（Decision Integrity Chain™, DIC™）——一个八层治理框架；FUSE/STAGE技术架构栈。
AI.method: 四个案例研究：硅谷银行（2023年3月）、Knight Capital集团（2012年8月）、英国"金边"市场崩溃（2022年9月）、信贷智能体决策失败。同时审查EU AI Act、DORA、MAS FEAT和巴塞尔指引等监管框架。
AI.findings: 在四个失败案例中，35%至60%的公司损失直接归因于未能追踪、审计和响应决策。现有可解释性框架（LIME、SHAP、可解释模型）只能解释模型如何及为何得出某个决策，但无法回答该决策过程是否经过适当治理、可追踪和授权。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"决策回放"（Decision Replay）作为智能体金融机构的基础治理概念，弥补了现有可解释性框架在治理合规性方面的理论空白。在决策完整性链（DIC™）八层治理框架基础上，引入FUSE/STAGE技术架构栈，将治理理论操作化。
AI.practical_contributions: 为智能体金融机构提供可操作的决策治理框架，使机构能够在任何时候、通过任意数量的AI代理回放并治理决策，回溯到决策背后的政策和授权。帮助金融机构应对EU AI Act、DORA、MAS FEAT及巴塞尔指引等监管合规要求，减少因决策治理失败导致的重大损失（35%-60%）。

detail.abstract: Authorities and market participants have long been committed to strengthening the cybersecurity of the entire financial sector. The recent EU regulation on digital operational resilience (DORA) has introduced harmonized rules, including the requirement for certain financial institutions to conduct advanced cybersecurity tests – known as Threat-Led Penetration Testing (TLPT). This paper analyses the supply of TLPT services in Italy, assessing the sector’s size and examining the structure of the market. Based on a voluntary-response questionnaire, we evaluate the key characteristics of the supply side, including service volumes, enabling factors, and barriers to the sector’s development. The findings point to a dynamic and growing market, with a predominance of domestic providers. TLPT service provision is concentrated in the hands of a small number of players, and there is significant variability in the resources allocated to individual services, indicating a market offering that is not yet fully standardized. Regulatory frameworks coexist with proprietary methodologies. Among the main obstacles to market development are a shortage of skilled professionals and persistently high costs.

AI.tldr: 本文基于自愿回复问卷，分析了意大利威胁主导渗透测试（TLPT）服务的供给市场，发现该市场动态增长、以国内供应商为主，但集中度高、服务标准不一，面临专业人才短缺和高成本等障碍。
AI.research_question: 意大利TLPT服务供给市场的规模、结构及关键特征是什么？
AI.motivation: 欧盟《数字运营韧性法案》（DORA）要求部分金融机构开展高级网络安全测试（TLPT），但TLPT服务的供给市场尚未被系统研究，需要了解其现状以支持政策与市场发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场供给分析、产业组织理论、网络安全监管合规框架
AI.method: 采用自愿回复问卷调查法，评估意大利TLPT服务供给方的服务量、促进因素及发展障碍。
AI.findings: TLPT市场动态且增长，以国内供应商为主；市场集中度高，少数玩家主导；服务资源投入差异大，尚未完全标准化；监管框架与专有方法论并存；主要障碍是专业人才短缺和成本高昂。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统刻画了TLPT服务供给市场的结构和特征，填补了网络安全服务市场在监管驱动下的供给端研究空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估DORA实施效果提供依据，为金融机构选择TLPT服务商提供市场信息，为供应商识别市场机会与瓶颈提供参考。

detail.title: Who Pays for Payments?

publicationDetails.detailsText: Hong Kong Institute for Monetary and Financial Research (HKIMR) Research Paper No. 02/2026
publicationDetails.journalName: Hong Kong Institute for Monetary & Financial Research (HKIMR) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This paper is written by Mark Egan (Harvard University and NBER), Gregor Matvos (Northwestern University and NBER), Amit Seru (Stanford University and NBER), Lulu Wang (Northwestern University), and Vincent Yao (Georgia State University).

We use novel data on the composition and cost of payments across U.S. merchants to quantify consumer redistribution in the payment system. Cards charge interchange fees to merchants to fund consumer rewards. When merchants respond by raising prices for all consumers, users of low‑cost payment methods (e.g., cash and debit) cross‑subsidize high‑reward credit card users who shop at the same merchant. Large differences in interchange fees across payment methods imply that these cross‑subsidies can be substantial. However, two mechanisms substantially limit cross‑subsidization in practice. First, consumer sorting—where consumers who use different payment methods shop at different merchants—limits the exposure of cash and debit users to the effects of high interchange fees. Where users of different payment methods do overlap, such as at large grocery stores, interchange fees are 50 % lower due to a combination of sector discounts and private negotiations. We embed these facts in a sufficient‑statistics framework to quantify the welfare effects of interchange fees across consumer groups. We estimate that interchange fees transfer approximately $30 billion every year from cash and debit users (who pay higher retail prices) to credit‑card users (who receive rewards). These transfers are comparable in scale but opposite in direction to major government transfer programs. Consumer sorting and merchant fee heterogeneity reduce regressivity by 25 %, but do not eliminate it. Finally, we show that both the Durbin Amendment and the recent rise of premium credit cards have been regressive, with significant implications for competition, regulation, and the distributional impact of financial innovation.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国商户支付数据，量化了支付系统中的消费者再分配效应：信用卡用户通过高额奖励从现金和借记卡用户那里获得每年约300亿美元的隐性转移支付。消费者分类和商户费率异质性将再分配的累退性降低了25%，但仍未能消除。
AI.research_question: 支付系统中不同支付方式用户之间的交叉补贴规模有多大？哪些机制限制了这种交叉补贴？
AI.motivation: 信用卡通过向商户收取交换费（interchange fees）来为消费者提供奖励，商户则通过提高所有消费者的价格来转嫁成本，导致使用低成本支付方式（现金、借记卡）的用户补贴高回报信用卡用户。但这种交叉补贴在实践中的程度和限制机制尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 充分统计量框架（sufficient-statistics framework），用于量化不同消费者群体之间交换费的福利效应。
AI.method: 利用美国商户支付构成和成本的新数据，结合消费者分类（sorting）和商户费率异质性分析，构建充分统计量框架进行福利量化。
AI.findings: 1. 交换费每年从现金和借记卡用户向信用卡用户转移约300亿美元；2. 消费者分类（不同支付方式用户在不同商户购物）和商户费率异质性（如大型超市费率低50%）将交叉补贴的累退性降低了25%；3. 德宾修正案（Durbin Amendment）和高端信用卡的兴起均具有累退性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统量化了支付系统中消费者再分配的规模和方向，揭示了消费者分类和商户费率谈判作为限制交叉补贴的关键机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为支付系统监管（如交换费上限政策）和金融创新的分配效应提供了实证依据，表明政策制定需关注不同消费者群体之间的隐性转移支付。

title: When the Protocol Decides - Replay Ready Infarstructure for Programmable Financial Institutions

detail.title: When the Protocol Decides - Replay Ready Infarstructure for Programmable Financial Institutions
detail.abstract:
The rails are becoming intelligent. The governance frameworks developed to manage them remain as before. In the ASEAN+3 group, the financial infrastructure stack is undergoing redesign, starting from the message layer upward. Project Nexus connects national payment systems at near-real-time speeds. ISO 20022 incorporates compliance controls within the financial messages themselves. Project Agorá brings programmable settlement to a distributed ledger. AI is parsing liquidity, fraud, identity, and credit information even before humans can see the information. 

This paper presents a simple yet powerful illustration of its main thesis: One decision, three jurisdictions, seven seconds. Decision chains start unfolding themselves at 09:43:17. Seven decisions by machines. No one ever saw them happen. Frameworks did not track them. The decision was reached prior to any supervision becoming necessary. 

Just as the protocol sets off executing its independent chain of decisions on jurisdictional, machine agent, and settlement layers simultaneously, four structural mismatches materialize, which none of our existing governance models could have anticipated in advance. 

This is the third paper in the Decision Engineering™ Series. Paper 1, "Reimagining the Future of Banking in a Protocol-Driven World," identifies the direction that banking was heading. Paper2, "The Irrecoverable Institution," demonstrated what breaks at single-institution level: replayability - not explainability - is the correct governance standard. 

This paper examines why things break when multiple programmable institutions start interacting with one another and deciding in a network fashion and presents a diagnostic and solution architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了在智能金融基础设施（如Nexus、ISO 20022、Agorá项目及AI系统）中，多司法管辖区、多机器代理的决策链在七秒内自动执行完成，而现有治理框架完全无法追踪或预见这些结构性错配。这是决策工程系列论文的第三篇，诊断了当多个可编程机构以网络化方式交互时出现的四大结构性错配，并提出了诊断与解决方案架构。
AI.research_question: 当多个可编程金融机构在网络化环境中相互交互并自主决策时，现有治理框架为何失效？出现了哪些结构性错配？
AI.motivation: 现有的金融治理框架是为传统人工监督环境设计的，无法适应智能基础设施（AI、协议、分布式账本）驱动的自动化、跨司法管辖区的多代理决策链，存在严重的监管盲区。
AI.theoretical_framework: 决策工程（Decision Engineering™）框架；可重放性（Replayability）而非可解释性作为正确的治理标准（来自论文2）；协议驱动下的多机构网络化决策理论。
AI.method: 案例演绎：通过一个虚拟但具代表性的场景（"一次决策，三个司法管辖区，七秒钟"）展示多机器代理的决策链如何自动展开，从而识别出四种结构性错配。
AI.findings: 四种结构性错配：（1）跨司法管辖区决策的时序错配；（2）机器代理层面的责任归属错配；（3）结算层面的同步性错配；（4）现有治理框架的认知与追踪能力错配。这些错配在决策完成后才显现，而人类监督者对此毫不知情。
AI.theory_contributions: 将治理标准从可解释性推进到可重放性；提出多机构网络化决策的结构性错配诊断框架；拓展了协议驱动治理的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了诊断新型金融基础设施治理漏洞的分析工具；为金融机构设计合规的可编程交互协议提供了架构建议。

detail.title: The Tax Creditor under European Insolvency Law: Special Treatment, Equal Treatment, or Even Worse?

publicationDetails.journalName: Max Planck Institute for Tax Law & Public Finance Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Unpaid tax liabilities are a common feature of almost every business insolvency or restructuring case. However, the legal treatment of such claims varies significantly across insolvency jurisdictions, both throughout Europe and beyond. This discrepancy is particularly pronounced in the context of taxes owed to foreign tax authorities. In an effort to contextualize current developments in the field, including recent decisions of the European Court of Justice and cases pending at the Court, the paper will address the issue from three different angles, each informed by, but not limited to, the European legal landscape. Based on comparative insights from Europe and beyond, it will comprise an analysis of the economics of the tax creditor and its implications on bankruptcy law, scrutinize the tax creditor’s treatment under harmonized European insolvency law, and explore the (foreign) tax creditor’s position in cross-border bankruptcy cases. With that threefold approach, the paper aims to answering a broad set of questions concerning the incorporation of (public-law governed) tax debt into the (private-law induced) collective procedure established under bankruptcy law: Do—and should—bankruptcy regimes afford special treatment to tax claims, e.g. by means of (super-)priority in the ranking of claims or an exclusion from restrictions under bankruptcy law? How should multi-level federal structures deal with tax claims—and does the approach taken under the current EU Directives fit the bill? What challenges arise in relation to foreign tax debt under the public international law principle of state sovereignty and how—if at all—does EU private international law deal with this issue? May the forum concursus modify foreign tax debt in a restructuring plan, wipe it out in a discharge, or even claw back previous payments made to the tax creditor through an avoidance action? While these issues may seem rather disconnected at first glance, there is an underlying common theme informing many of the open questions, problems, and potential solutions concerning tax claims and their treatment under bankruptcy law, that is, their origins in public law, and the tax creditor’s sovereign powers.

AI.tldr: 本文从经济学、欧盟统一破产法和跨境破产三个维度，系统分析了破产程序中税收债权的特殊待遇问题，尤其聚焦于外国税收债权在主权原则下的处理困境。
AI.research_question: 破产法应如何对待（外国）税收债权？税收债权的公法属性如何影响其在破产集体清偿程序中的地位？
AI.motivation: 税收债权在破产案件中普遍存在，但各国对其法律待遇差异显著，尤其是对外国税收债权的处理更为复杂。近年欧洲法院的判决和待审案件凸显了这一问题的重要性和紧迫性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公法与私法的交叉理论、税收债权人的主权权力理论、多层级联邦结构下的税收处理理论、欧盟私国际法中的主权原则。
AI.method: 比较法分析（欧洲及域外）、经济学分析、判例分析（欧洲法院判决及待审案件）、欧盟指令文本分析。
AI.findings: 1) 破产制度是否应给予税收债权特殊待遇（如超级优先权或豁免限制）存在争议；2) 欧盟现行指令对多层级联邦结构中税收债权的处理方式未必合理；3) 外国税收债权面临国家主权原则下的重大挑战；4) 破产法院能否修改、免除外国税收债务或撤销已向其支付的款项，仍是悬而未决的问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统整合了税收债权公法属性对破产法的多维影响，揭示了主权权力与集体清偿程序之间的根本张力，为理解破产中税收债权的诸多开放问题提供了统一的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟及各国立法者在破产法改革中处理税收债权（尤其是跨境税收债权）提供了比较法参考和政策建议，对欧洲法院待审案件的分析具有现实指导意义。

title: Wasserstein Risk-Sensitive Appointment Scheduling under Delay Constraints
affiliations: Purdue University - Krannert School of Management, School of Economics and Management, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences and University of Chinese Academy of Sciences - School of Economics and Management

detail.title: Wasserstein Risk-Sensitive Appointment Scheduling under Delay Constraints
detail.abstract: We consider a risk-averse appointment scheduling problem for a healthcare service delivery system with discrete appointment times and service-duration ambiguity, focusing on the tradeoff between overtime work and patient delays. We employ conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) to measure the risk, and to address the ambiguity, we develop a distributionally robust optimization (DRO) model over a type-1 Wasserstein ball centered at an empirical service-duration distribution. We show that the Wasserstein DRO model enjoys a regularized reformulation, which captures an empirical-risk effect and a position-differentiated effect on synthesized aversion to risk and ambiguity. The regularized reformulation provides an important operational insight of position-differentiated robustness for delay management under service-duration ambiguity, without incurring additional complexity. Leveraging the regularized reformulations, the optimal schedule can be determined efficiently by evaluating the empirical CVaRs with binary search for each position sequentially. We then perform sensitivity analysis and derive finite-sample and asymptotic performance guarantees for the obtained optimal schedule. Furthermore, we extend our model to incorporate sequencing decisions for multiple types of patients, which also exploits the regularization structure and can be solved as one instance of mixed-integer linear program. Finally, numerical experiments demonstrate the insights and performance of the proposed approach.

AI.tldr: 本文针对医疗服务系统中的风险厌恶型预约排程问题，提出了基于Wasserstein球的分布式鲁棒优化模型，通过正则化重构有效处理服务时长不确定性，实现加班与患者等待之间的权衡，并给出了高效求解方法和性能保证。
AI.research_question: 如何在服务时长不确定的条件下，设计风险厌恶的预约排程方案，以优化加班成本与患者等待时间之间的权衡？
AI.motivation: 医疗服务系统中的预约排程面临服务时长不确定性的挑战，传统的确定性或随机优化方法难以有效控制极端风险。需要在风险规避和模糊厌恶下找到兼顾效率与鲁棒性的排程策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 条件风险价值（CVaR）、分布鲁棒优化（DRO）、类型-1 Wasserstein球、正则化重构
AI.method: 构建基于Wasserstein球的分布鲁棒优化模型，利用正则化重构将问题转化为可高效求解的形式，结合二分搜索逐位置求解最优排程，并扩展到多类型患者的排序决策，使用混合整数线性规划求解。
AI.findings: Wasserstein DRO模型可转化为具有经验风险效应和位置差异化效应的正则化形式；位置差异化鲁棒性可以有效应对服务时长模糊性而不增加计算复杂度；最优排程可通过逐位置的二分搜索高效获取；提供了有限样本和渐近性能保障。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了服务时长模糊下预约排程的正则化重构理论，揭示了位置差异化鲁棒性的运营洞察；建立了有限样本与渐近性能的理论保证。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗服务系统提供了可高效计算的风险厌恶型预约排程方法，支持多类型患者的排序决策，帮助医疗机构在不确定环境下平衡加班成本与患者等待时间。

title: The Myth of Deglobalization: Evidence for Continued Global Economic Integration

detail.title: The Myth of Deglobalization: Evidence for Continued Global Economic Integration
detail.abstract: In recent years, influenced by the COVID-19, geopolitical conflicts, and tradeprotectionism rising, more and more opinions think that global economy is becomingdeglobalization and granulation. These phenomena make international trade andglobal value chains become more unstable in some degrees (International MonetaryFund [IMF], 2023). In my presentation, I think the deglobalization trend is strengthen. But from long-term and structural view, these changes more react the short-termimpact and phased adjustment, which is not a fundamental reversal of non-globalization. So, in the rest of future decade, globalization won’t being replaced by deglobalization. The structural dependence of global supply chains, new globalization pushedbydigital economy, and kept expansion of multinational companies, still push global economy integration (Antràs, 2020; Baldwin, 2016).

AI.tldr: 本文认为当前所谓的"去全球化"趋势更多是短期冲击和阶段性调整，而非全球化的根本逆转。未来十年，全球供应链的结构性依赖、数字经济驱动的新全球化以及跨国公司的持续扩张，仍将推动全球经济一体化。
AI.research_question: 当前全球经济是否正在经历去全球化？这是一个根本性逆转还是阶段性调整？
AI.motivation: 受COVID-19、地缘政治冲突和贸易保护主义影响，越来越多观点认为全球经济正在走向去全球化和碎片化，需要对此进行辨析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球化结构性依赖理论、数字经济驱动的新全球化理论、跨国公司扩张理论（参考Antràs, 2020; Baldwin, 2016）
AI.method: 观点论述与文献综述（引用IMF 2023报告、Antràs 2020、Baldwin 2016等文献支持论点）
AI.findings: 去全球化趋势虽在短期加强，但从长期和结构性视角看，这并非全球化的根本逆转；全球供应链的结构性依赖、数字经济推动的新全球化、跨国公司的持续扩张仍将推动全球经济一体化。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了短期冲击与长期结构趋势，提出"全球化未被去全球化取代"的理论判断。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和企业提供对全球化趋势的理性认知，避免因短期波动而做出过度反应。

title: A Hybrid Deep Learning-Association Rule Model for Forecasting S&P 500 Sectors Returns
affiliations: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University and National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University

detail.title: A Hybrid Deep Learning-Association Rule Model for Forecasting S&P 500 Sectors Returns
detail.abstract: This study proposes a hybrid deep learning framework that integrates Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks with Association Rule (AR) mining to improve stock market prediction within the S&P 500. Twenty-two representative firms from eleven GICS sectors are selected, covering the period 2010-2024 with daily OHLCV data enriched by technical indicators such as moving averages, Bollinger Bands, MACD, and volatility measures. The LSTM component captures nonlinear temporal dependencies in stock returns, while the AR layer introduces interpretable cross-market validation signals derived from global indices. Unlike prior studies that depend on high-frequency data or institutional-scale computing, this research highlights the feasibility of implementing hybrid deep learning using personal computers. Empirical evidence demonstrates that the LSTM with AR framework consistently outperforms traditional baselines, including Logistic Regression and Buy-and-Hold strategies, providing enhanced robustness, interpretability, and practical relevance for individual investors in algorithmic trading applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种融合LSTM与关联规则挖掘的混合深度学习框架，用于标普500股票预测。利用2010-2024年22家代表公司的日度OHLCV数据及技术指标，该框架在个人电脑上实现，优于逻辑回归和买入持有策略，为个人投资者提供可解释且稳健的算法交易方案。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个兼具预测精度与可解释性的混合深度学习框架，使个人投资者能够在普通计算资源下实现有效的股票市场预测？
AI.motivation: 现有股票预测研究多依赖高频数据或大规模计算资源，对个人投资者不友好；同时，纯深度学习模型缺乏可解释性，难以理解跨市场信号。
AI.theoretical_framework: LSTM网络（捕捉非线性时序依赖）+ 关联规则挖掘（引入全球指数的可解释跨市场验证信号）
AI.method: 选取S&P 500中11个GICS行业的22家代表公司，使用2010-2024年日度OHLCV数据及技术指标（移动平均、布林带、MACD、波动率指标），构建LSTM+AR混合框架，在个人电脑上训练与回测。
AI.findings: LSTM+AR框架在预测准确率、稳健性和可解释性上一致优于逻辑回归和买入持有等传统基准策略，且可在个人电脑上有效运行。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出将关联规则挖掘作为可解释性层与LSTM时序建模相结合的混合框架，拓展了深度学习在金融预测中的可解释性研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 证明了个人投资者无需高频数据或高端计算资源即可部署有效的混合深度学习算法交易策略，降低了量化交易的技术门槛。

detail.abstract: Stewardship, which encompasses shareholder voting activities and engagement with company management, can strengthen the role of investors in steering companies towards long-term value creation. As investors increasingly integrate ESG considerations into their investment strategies, stewardship is becoming more central to encouraging companies to meet sustainability standards. This paper focuses on the stewardship practices of a sample of asset managers and, to a lesser extent, central banks. The survey suggests that a ‘one size fits all’ approach to stewardship is inadequate for meeting the goals of different investors, due to their potentially differing assessments of the trade-offs involved.

AI.tldr: 本文调查了资产管理者和中央银行在尽责管理（stewardship）方面的实践，发现由于不同投资者对权衡因素的评估存在差异，采取"一刀切"的方法无法满足其不同目标。
AI.research_question: 不同类型的投资者（资产管理者与中央银行）在尽责管理实践中是否存在差异？"一刀切"的尽责管理方法是否足以满足不同投资者的目标？
AI.motivation: 随着ESG因素日益融入投资策略，尽责管理在推动企业满足可持续发展标准方面变得越来越重要，但不同投资者对相关权衡的评估可能不同，需要深入调查其具体实践。
AI.theoretical_framework: 尽责管理理论、ESG投资理论、利益相关者理论
AI.method: 调查研究法（survey），以资产管理者为主要样本，以中央银行为辅助样本
AI.findings: "一刀切"的尽责管理方法不足以满足不同投资者的目标，因为不同投资者对尽责管理中的权衡（trade-offs）存在不同评估。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了尽责管理的异质性特征，挑战了单一尽责管理模式的有效性假设，为差异化尽责管理策略提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为资产管理者、中央银行及政策制定者提供了尽责管理实践中需要考虑差异化策略的实证依据，有助于设计更符合不同投资者目标的可持续投资框架。

detail.abstract: This paper presents a research framework investigating the application of explainable reinforcement learning (XRL) to risk-aware portfolio optimization in Indian emerging equity markets. Existing machine learning models for quantitative finance predominantly target developed markets and prioritize return maximization, often at the expense of interpretability and downside risk management. This research addresses three critical gaps: the absence of XAI-integrated RL frameworks calibrated for portfolio construction; the underrepresentation of Indian market dynamics in quantitative finance research; and the lack of empirical validation using live fund data. Leveraging proprietary trading datasets from two operational investment funds Nifty Money (UK) and Nimo (India)-this paper proposes and formalize a novel XRL framework. The expected contribution is a theoretically grounded, empirically validated, and practically deployable framework that advances the state of the art in interpretable AI for quantitative fund management.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向印度新兴股票市场的可解释强化学习（XRL）风险管理投资组合优化框架，利用两个运营投资基金的真实交易数据，填补了XAI与RL在投资组合构建中的整合空白，并提供了可落地的实证方案。

detail.title: Rethinking the Antitrust-Securities Interface
detail.abstract: This article proposes a new theoretical framework for resolving conflicts between antitrust law and securities regulation, which is distinctive in four respects. First, it eschews the traditional approach of resolving antitrust-securities conflicts through implied antitrust immunity, which unjustifiably prioritizes securities regulation above antitrust law. Second, it argues for a narrow definition of conflict, encompassing only conduct presently authorized or required by the securities regime that also has likely and significantly anticompetitive effects; practices illegal under both antitrust law and securities regulation are thereby excluded. Third, this article builds on the literature on the antitrust-intellectual property interface to recommend a structured, rule-of-reason framework for resolving conflicts at the antitrust-securities interface. Unlike implied antitrust immunity, which automatically allows securities regulation concerns to trump antitrust concerns, the rule of reason seeks to strike a proper balance. The analysis begins by asking whether the securities practice has likely and significantly anticompetitive effects. It then inquires into the securities regulation concerns behind the conduct and whether there is a less restrictive means of addressing those concerns. Fourth, a two-stage procedure is proposed for implementing the rule of reason to resolve antitrust-securities conflicts in rulemaking and adjudication, involving the collaboration of the Securities and Exchange Commission, the Department of Justice, and the courts.

title: The Inverted Benefit Corporation: OpenAI and the Limits of Mission Governance

detail.title: The Inverted Benefit Corporation: OpenAI and the Limits of Mission Governance
detail.abstract:
In October 2025, OpenAI converted from a nonprofit-controlled LLC to a nonprofit-controlled Delaware public benefit corporation, culminating in a two-year governance crisis and producing the most elaborate mission-control design in the frontier AI sector. This paper argues that the resulting structure generates real friction but fires on the wrong triggers. 


Delaware's PBC statute was built for for-profit entities adding a public-benefit purpose. OpenAI deployed the form in the opposite direction: a mission-driven entity adopting the PBC to legitimize profit. That directional inversion causes three statutory mechanisms to misfire. The protective function, designed to shield mission-minded deviation from a profit baseline, now shields profit-ward deviation from a mission baseline. Section 102(b)(7) exculpation immunizes the very decisions a mission-controlled entity most needs to police. And the interaction between a diffuse public-goods mission and a newly legitimate profit motive leaves no benchmark against which directorial balancing can be tested. 


Even a tightened PBC regime would not reach the risks that matter most: sustained commercial pressure that never triggers a formal checkpoint, sovereign compulsion that exceeds any private actor's capacity to resist, and unilateral executive action that bypasses governance entirely. The February 2026 confrontation between Anthropic and the Department of Defense supplies the stress test. OpenAI, with the most elaborate mission-governance overlay in the sector, did not visibly resist the government's demands; Anthropic, with a thinner structural overlay but a leader willing to absorb existential commercial risk, did. What distinguished the two outcomes was leadership conviction, not corporate form. 


Structure cannot prevent governance failure, but it can make failure visible, costly, and subject to external response. That visibility creates the predicate for the federal regulatory frameworks that do not yet exist.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了OpenAI在2025年转型为特拉华州公益公司（PBC）后的治理结构，指出该结构虽然复杂精巧，但存在根本性的“方向性反转”问题：PBC本是为营利实体增加公益目的而设计，OpenAI却将其反向用于为使命导向实体合法化营利行为。这种倒置导致三项法定机制失灵。更关键的是，即便完善PBC制度，也无法防范商业压力、主权强制和高管单边行动等真正的治理风险。2026年2月Anthropic与国防部的对抗案例表明，真正区分治理结果的是领导层的信念而非公司形式。
AI.research_question: OpenAI转型为特拉华州公益公司（PBC）的治理结构是否有效？PBC法律框架在“使命导向实体反向引入营利目的”这一特殊情境下能否发挥预期功能？
AI.motivation: OpenAI的治理危机和转型代表了前沿AI领域最具野心的“使命控制”设计尝试，但其结构性缺陷和现实中的治理失效需要系统分析，以为未来的AI监管框架提供经验教训。
AI.theoretical_framework: 特拉华州公益公司法（PBC statute）的法定机制理论；公司治理中的“方向性反转”理论；使命驱动型组织的治理架构设计理论。
AI.method: 法律结构分析（对PBC三项法定机制的文本与功能分析）；案例比较分析（OpenAI vs. Anthropic在国防部冲突中的不同应对）。
AI.findings: 1. PBC的三项机制在OpenAI的“反向使用”情境下均发生失火：保护功能从保护使命偏离利润基准逆转为保护利润偏离使命基准；免责条款为最需要监控的决策提供豁免；公益使命与营利动机之间缺乏可检验的衡量基准。2. 即便是加强后的PBC制度也无法触及真正风险：持续商业压力、主权强制、高管单边行动。3. 2026年Anthropic与国防部的对抗显示，领导层信念（而非公司形式）才是决定治理结果的关键变量。4. 结构的价值不在于防止治理失败，而在于使失败可见、可代价化和可外部追责。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了PBC法律框架的“方向性反转”理论，揭示了同一法定机制在不同使用方向下的功能变异；区分了“形式上精巧的治理架构”与“实质上有效的治理能力”之间的鸿沟。
AI.practical_contributions: 为前沿AI公司的治理结构设计提供了警示性案例；指出联邦监管框架的必要性——治理结构无法替代外部监管，但可以使治理失败“可见化”从而为监管创造条件。

detail.abstract: Drawing on a case study of a large Australian business school, we examine how the formalisation of grant income as an additional performance metric reopened and reconfigured evaluative arrangements among academics. Mobilising the Economies of Worth framework (Boltanski & Thévenot, 2006), we conceptualise proliferating metrics as contested tests of worth that reopen workable evaluative settlements rather than simply extending existing control systems. Our analysis shows that the implementation of grant income marked a critical moment, intensifying tensions between coexisting worlds and prompting renewed justificatory work among Heads of Department (HoDs) and academics. Across four departments, we identify three distinct evaluative settlements, each reflecting different accommodations of metric proliferation. These settlements differed in how grant income was justified, which orders of worth were selectively mobilised, and how HoDs as middle managers mediated institutional expectations through departmental implementation. We contribute to research on academic performance measurement by showing how metric proliferation can produce distinct settlements rather than uniform responses, and by highlighting the pivotal role of HoDs as middle managers in implementing new evaluative demands amid enduring plurality. We also highlight how, in the reframed settlement, market-based justifications of industry funding supported the emergence of a new academic identity: the entrepreneurial academic.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对一所大型澳大利亚商学院案例研究，运用"价值经济"框架分析研究经费指标化如何重新配置学术评价体系。研究发现，经费指标的实施在不同系所产生了三种不同的评价性妥协方案，系主任作为中层管理者在其中发挥关键调节作用，并催生了"创业型学者"这一新学术身份。

AI.theory_contributions: （1）揭示指标激增能产生差异化的评价性妥协，而非统一回应；（2）强调系主任作为中层管理者在实施新评价要求、调和多元价值中的关键角色；（3）展示在重构的评价安排中，市场正当性如何塑造新的学术身份。

detail.abstract: The accounting for carbon credits and greenhouse gas (GHG) emission obligations remains one of the most significant gaps in International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS). Since the withdrawal of IFRIC 3 Emission Rights in 2005, entities have relied on a patchwork of existing standards (IAS 38, IAS 2, IAS 20 and IAS 37), leading to recurring accounting mismatches between the measurement of environmental assets and the corresponding emission obligations. This discussion paper proposes a comprehensive Dual-Purpose Framework based on the entity's business model and the economic function of the instrument. For compliance (cap-andtrade) markets, the framework links the measurement of the emission liability directly to the carrying amount of the allowances held for surrender, while measuring any uncovered shortfall at current market value. For voluntary carbon markets (VCM) and trading portfolios, the framework prescribes a Fair Value Through Profit or Loss (FVTPL) model. The analysis addresses counterpart entries, liability-side consequences, disclosure architecture, sector applications and transition pathways. It also maps emerging technical questions likely to generate near-term standard-setting demand, including credit integrity, reversal and invalidation risk, registrybased control, structured carbon contracts, interoperability across registries and jurisdictions, and the interaction between financial reporting and climate-related disclosures.

detail.abstract: The United States spent $5.28 trillion on healthcare in 2024, 18.0% of its entire GDP and yet outcomes in many key metrics lag behind comparable nations. Central to this paradox is the disproportionate growth of administrative and non-clinical costs: $372 billion in 2024, representing 7.0% of total national health expenditures and growing at 872% since 1990, far outpacing hospital care (385%) and physician services (419%). This study analyzes 65 years of CMS National Health Expenditure (NHE) data across 25 detailed tables covering total spending, payer mix, service categories, and per-capita trends. Using time-series analysis, correlation analysis (r = 0.998, p < 0.001), growth indexing, payer mix decomposition, and projection modeling, this paper documents the structural drivers of U.S. healthcare financial inefficiency. Drawing on stakeholder analytics theory (Yalley, 2025a) and the limitations of narrow valueoptimization frameworks (Yalley, 2025b), this paper argues that administrative cost growth is a governance failure requiring analytics-driven structural reform.

declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patients, animals, or identifiable personal data. Ethics approval was therefore not required.

detail.abstract: Autonomous systems are being fielded across safety-critical and security-critical domains faster than the architectures that should constrain them. This paper addresses the resulting authority-governance gap. We propose AUTHREX, a seven-stage authority lifecycle architecture comprising sensor trust attestation, hierarchical authority computation, adversarial deception detection, multi-agent integrity verification, deliberation-window enforcement, deterministic recovery, and escalation-risk quantification. The architecture is technology-neutral and is instantiated in six hardware platforms spanning directed-energy, automotive, maritime, critical-infrastructure, ground-mobility, and aerial domains. We validate the architecture through TLA+ formal verification across 48,751 reachable states, eight safety properties, and zero violations, and through empirical simulation across more than 2,800 adversarial runs in seven fault-injection scenarios, observing a 92 percent reduction in unsafe actions versus a binary-threshold baseline and an 82 percent reduction versus standard Simplex switching. We compare AUTHREX to runtime-assurance, safety-case, and verification-of-learning-component alternatives, identifying three architectural primitives absent or underdeveloped in those approaches: continuous trust evaluation as a system primitive, graded scalar authority, and adversarial-deception-aware modulation. We discuss limitations including single-investigator validation, the simulation-versus-operational-evidence gap, and the breadth-depth trade-off in cross-domain coverage. The contribution is the integrated treatment of safety, security, and adversarial conditions in a single formally-verified hardware-validated framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AUTHREX——一个七阶段权威生命周期架构，整合安全、安保与对抗性条件，在6个硬件平台验证，通过TLA+形式化验证和2800+对抗模拟，实现92%的不安全行为减少。
AI.research_question: 如何弥合自主系统在安全关键与安全关键领域部署速度与其约束架构之间的权威-治理差距？
AI.motivation: 自主系统在安全关键和安保关键领域的部署速度快于约束它们的架构，导致权威-治理差距（authority-governance gap），现有方法缺乏对安全、安保和对抗性条件的统一处理。
AI.theoretical_framework: AUTHREX七阶段权威生命周期架构，包含：传感器信任认证、层级权威计算、对抗性欺骗检测、多智能体完整性验证、审议窗口执行、确定性恢复、升级风险量化。
AI.method: 1) TLA+形式化验证（48,751个可达状态，8个安全属性，零违规）；2) 超过2,800次对抗模拟（7种故障注入场景）；3) 在6个硬件平台（定向能、汽车、海事、关键基础设施、地面移动、空中）实例化。
AI.findings: 相比二元阈值基线减少92%的不安全行为，相比标准Simplex切换减少82%的不安全行为。识别出三种现有方法缺失或不足的架构原语：作为系统原语的持续信任评估、分级标量权威、对抗性欺骗感知调制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将安全、安保和对抗性条件统一整合在一个形式化验证的框架中的集成处理方法；识别了三种架构原语作为未来研究的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了技术中立的七阶段权威生命周期架构，可在6种不同硬件平台实例化；通过形式化验证和大量模拟证明了有效性，为自主系统安全部署提供了实用框架。

title: Closing the AI Adoption Gap: Introducing A People-First Framework for Implementing AI in the Workplace Without Creating Employee Resistance

detail.title: Closing the AI Adoption Gap: Introducing A People-First Framework for Implementing AI in the Workplace Without Creating Employee Resistance

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence is rapidly becoming part of everyday work, but many organizations are struggling to turn AI access into real adoption. Business leaders often see AI as a path to productivity, automation, workflow efficiency, and competitive advantage. Employees, however, may experience AI as unclear, risky, poorly integrated, or threatening to their role. This whitepaper examines the AI adoption gap between executive expectations and employee reality, with a focus on employee trust, resistance, training, workflow fit, quality standards, and responsible AI governance. Drawing from workplace AI adoption research, organizational change management guidance, AI governance frameworks, and real world enterprise AI use cases, this whitepaper explains why many AI rollouts fail and how leaders can avoid the most common mistakes. It introduces a People-First AI Implementation Framework (PFAIF) built around assessing workflows, defining use cases, communicating the reason for change, training by role, setting quality standards, piloting before scaling, measuring adoption and trust, and reinforcing what works. This whitepaper is written for business owners, executives, department leaders, HR leaders, operations leaders, and other decision makers responsible for implementing AI into the workforce in a way that improves productivity without damaging employee trust, morale, or collaboration.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了企业中AI采纳的鸿沟——高管期望与员工现实之间的差距，并提出了一套以人为先的AI实施框架（PFAIF），帮助企业提高AI采纳率的同时维护员工信任与士气。
AI.research_question: 为什么许多组织在将AI接入转化为实际采纳过程中面临困难？如何弥合高管期望与员工现实之间的AI采纳鸿沟？
AI.motivation: 虽然AI正迅速成为日常工作的一部分，但许多组织在推动AI采纳时遭遇员工信任不足、抵触情绪、培训缺失、工作流不匹配等问题，导致AI推广失败率较高。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI采纳鸿沟理论、组织变革管理理论、AI治理框架；以及本文提出的People-First AI Implementation Framework (PFAIF)
AI.method: 白皮书式综述研究，综合了职场AI采纳研究、组织变革管理指南、AI治理框架以及真实企业AI使用案例。
AI.findings: AI推广失败的主要原因包括：员工缺乏信任、感知风险、培训不足、与现有工作流不匹配、质量标准不明确。成功的关键在于以人为先，系统性地评估工作流、定义用例、沟通变革原因、按角色培训、设定质量标准、先试点再推广、衡量采纳与信任、强化有效做法。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了People-First AI Implementation Framework (PFAIF)，将员工信任与采纳行为纳入AI实施的核心考量，补充了现有AI采纳研究中对人与组织因素的关注不足。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业决策者提供了可操作的八步实施框架，帮助企业在提升生产力的同时维护员工信任、士气和协作，减少AI推行的阻力与失败风险。

title: Cross-Domain Mapping of Structural Tensions: Applying the ZTH Model Across Health, Finance, Projects and Environment

detail.title: Cross-Domain Mapping of Structural Tensions: Applying the ZTH Model Across Health, Finance, Projects and Environment
